production.translationZh: 这种创作金字塔得以持续存在的一个原因是，在过去半个世纪里，世界上大部分的媒体文化都由单一媒介——电视——所定义，而电视的本质就是下载。

physical.sentenceEn: For instance, as convenient and provocative, AI enables virtual try-on experiences where you can virtually test makeup, hairstyles, clothing, and even cosmetic procedures before making any physical changes.
physical.translationZh: 例如，人工智能提供了既便捷又具启发性的体验，让你在进行任何实际改变之前，能够虚拟尝试化妆、发型、服装，甚至美容整形手术。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

physical.sentenceEn: (And yes, all these benefits are more closely associated with physical books than digital ones.)
physical.translationZh: （没错，所有这些优点与纸质书的相关性都要比电子书更高。）

physical.sentenceEn: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence, the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
physical.translationZh: 该审查报告建议发起一项全国性的品牌宣传活动，以增强图书馆的实体感；重新推行一项让会员持卡即可使用全国任一图书馆的计划；以及为儿童自动办理入会手续。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

physical.sentenceEn: As desire paths criss-cross through both physical and virtual landscapes, they stand as a proof of the collective insistence on forging unconventional routes and embracing the spirit of communal choice.
physical.translationZh: 当欲望小径在现实与虚拟空间中纵横交错，它们成为了集体坚持开辟非常规路线、拥抱共同选择精神的证明。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

physical.sentenceEn: Stealing artifacts from other peoples' cultures is obscene; it robs not only the physical objects, but the dignity and spirit of their creators.
physical.translationZh: 窃取其他民族文化的文物是令人不齿的行为；这不仅夺走了实物，更剥夺了其创造者的尊严与精神。
physical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

project.sentenceEn: Georgia offers up to 30% in transferable tax credits on film and TV production costs, plus an additional 10% increase on the base tax credit if the project includes a Georgia promotional logo.
project.translationZh: 佐治亚州为电影和电视制作成本提供高达 30% 的可转让税收抵免。此外，如果项目包含了佐治亚州的宣传标识，还可以在基础税收抵免之上再获得 10% 的额度提升。
project.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

project.sentenceEn: This form of accessible science means that great minds are able to join the race to create and develop projects with the potential to change the world.
project.translationZh: 这种易于获取的科学形式意味着，众多杰出人才能够加入到创造和开发具有改变世界潜力的项目的行列中来。
project.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

project.sentenceEn: You don't even need any formal training, just an inquisitive mind and the enthusiasm to join one of the thousands of citizen science projects to generate new knowledge and the means to understand a genuine scientific outcome.
project.translationZh: 你甚至不需要任何正式培训，只需要一颗好奇的心和参与数千个公民科学项目的热情，就能为新知识的产生贡献力量，并理解真正的科学成果。
project.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

project.sentenceEn: The Nagpur project has already created a risk and vulnerability map, which enabled Kotharkar to tell officials which neighborhoods to focus on in the event of a heat wave this summer.
project.translationZh: 那格浦尔项目已绘制出风险与脆弱性地图，这使科萨尔卡尔能够告知官员们，今年夏季发生热浪时应重点关注哪些社区。
project.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

project.sentenceEn: High school students who have an impressive personal project they are working on independently often impress colleges, experts say.
project.translationZh: 专家表示，那些独立开展令人印象深刻的个人项目的高中生往往能给大学留下深刻印象。
project.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

project.sentenceEn: Builders possibly need to submit new estimates of their projects .
project.translationZh: 建筑商可能需要重新提交项目预算。

protection.sentenceEn: All this was put at great risk late last month, when the U.S. Supreme Court issued a ruling in an Idaho case that provides the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) far less authority to regulate wetlands and waterways.
protection.translationZh: 然而，所有这一切在上个月末陷入了巨大的危机——美国最高法院就爱达荷州的一起案件作出裁决，大幅削弱了美国环境保护局(EPA)对湿地和水道的监管权。
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

protection.sentenceEn: And so we would call on state lawmakers from Richmond to Albany to consider reviewing their own wetlands protections and see for themselves the enormous stakes involved.
protection.translationZh: 因此，我们呼吁从里士满到奥尔巴尼的各州立法者考虑审查各自的湿地保护措施，并亲自了解其中涉及的重大利害关系。
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

protection.sentenceEn: Will those jurisdictions extend the same protections now denied under Sackett v. EPA?
protection.translationZh: 那些辖区会提供萨基特诉美国环保局案中被剥夺的同等保护吗？
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

protection.sentenceEn: But it's also a lot more personal, Ortiz says, arguing that because art is so closely linked to a person, it could raise data protection and privacy problems.
protection.translationZh: 但奥尔蒂斯表示，这还涉及更深层次的个人问题。她认为，由于艺术与创作者本人有着千丝万缕的联系，这可能会引发数据保护和隐私方面的问题。
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

protection.sentenceEn: In Maryland, the good news is that there are many state laws in place that provide wetlands protections .
protection.translationZh: 在马里兰州，好消息是该州已出台多项法律为湿地提供保护。
protection.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

protection.sentenceEn: It has ensured the coordination of protection efforts.
protection.translationZh: 它确保了保护工作的协调统一。

professor.sentenceEn: One of the past winners, Professor Martin Green from the University of New South Wales, Australia, is the inventor of the Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell technology which is now found in most of the world's solar panels.
professor.translationZh: 往届获奖者之一、澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的马丁·格林教授是发射极和背面钝化电池技术的发明者，如今这项技术已应用于全球大多数太阳能电池板。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

professor.sentenceEn: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow.
professor.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯派洛指出，互联网可能仅仅改变了我们记忆的内容，而非我们的记忆能力。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

professor.sentenceEn: "There may be costs associated with our increased reliance on the Internet, but I'd have to imagine that overall the benefits are going to outweigh those costs," observes psychology professor Benjamin Storm.
professor.translationZh: 心理学教授本杰明·斯托姆指出：“我们对互联网的依赖加深可能会带来一些代价，但我认为总体而言，其益处将超过这些代价。”
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

professor.sentenceEn: As a zoology professor , I agree with Emma Marris that zoo displays can be sad and cruel.
professor.translationZh: 作为一名动物学教授，我同意艾玛·马里斯的观点，即动物园的展览可能既令人难过又残酷。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

professor.sentenceEn: Joana Lia Ferreira, an assistant professor of conservation and restoration at the NOVA School of Science and Technology, notes that archaeologists first defined the great material ages of human history—Stone Age, Iron Age, and so on—after examining artifacts in museums.
professor.translationZh: 新里斯本大学科学与技术学院的文物保护与修复助理教授乔安娜·莉娅·费雷拉指出，考古学家正是在研究了博物馆中的文物后，才首次定义了人类历史上伟大的材料时代——如石器时代、铁器时代等等。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

professor.sentenceEn: Regenerative products could be a hard sell, because the concept is tough to define quickly, says Julie Stanton, associate professor of agricultural economics at Pennsylvania State University Brandywine.
professor.translationZh: 宾夕法尼亚州立大学布兰德万恩分校农业经济学副教授朱莉·斯坦顿表示，再生农业产品可能很难推广，因为这个概念难以快速定义。
professor.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

promote.sentenceEn: There are so many products out there, being promoted with huge advertising and marketing budgets, that it's easy to fall victim.
promote.translationZh: 市面上有如此多的产品在巨额广告和营销预算的推波助澜下进行促销，以至于人们很容易成为受害者。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

promote.sentenceEn: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don't go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies.
promote.translationZh: 尽管英国政府最近出台了鼓励土地所有者多种树的新激励措施，但该行业机构表示，这些措施力度不够，未能充分宣传植树对增加木材供应的益处。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

promote.sentenceEn: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.
promote.translationZh: 企鹅兰登书屋的知名作家可能会受到些许影响，但真正盼望这场争端结束的，是那些中游作家——他们通常依赖水石书店员工对推广小众作家作品的热情。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

promote.sentenceEn: Armed with this insight, the marketing and engineering teams joined forces to raise awareness by prominently promoting the premium version to users of the free version.
promote.translationZh: 基于这一洞见，市场营销团队与工程团队联手合作，通过向免费版用户重点推广高级版来提高用户认知度。
promote.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

promote.sentenceEn: What can promote children's emotional literacy according to O'Hanlon?
promote.translationZh: 根据奥汉隆的观点，什么可以促进儿童的情感素养？

promote.sentenceEn: Waterstones staff hesitate to promote big-name authors' books.
promote.translationZh: 水石书店员工不愿推广知名作家的书籍。

productivity.sentenceEn: They have their reasons — around 63% of them report that using AI increases their productivity , and some even feel AI offers more help than their human colleagues.
productivity.translationZh: 他们有自己的理由——约 63% 的人表示使用 AI 提高了他们的生产力，有些人甚至觉得 AI 比人类同事提供的帮助更多。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第8句

productivity.sentenceEn: The situation presents a delicate balance between leveraging AI for its productivity gains and risking confidential data exposure.
productivity.translationZh: 当前的局势需要在利用人工智能提升生产力与承担机密数据泄露风险之间寻求微妙的平衡。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

productivity.sentenceEn: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle.
productivity.translationZh: 科伊尔表示，要提高更多人的生活水平并增进繁荣，就需要更多地利用数字技术来提高包括医疗保健和建筑业在内的各个行业的生产力。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

productivity.sentenceEn: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers' wages.
productivity.translationZh: 即便没有将工作置于风险之中，就业保护法只要在一定程度上限制企业主解雇表现不佳的管理人员，就会对企业生产力构成制约，进而影响工人工资。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

productivity.sentenceEn: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
productivity.translationZh: 严格的解雇法规会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并阻碍繁荣发展和整体福祉。
productivity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

productivity.sentenceEn: Which of the following measures would the Productivity Commission support?
productivity.translationZh: 以下哪项措施会得到生产力委员会的支持？

patent.sentenceEn: Critics make three main arguments against gene patents : a gene is a product of nature, so it may not be patented ; gene patents suppress innovation rather than reward it; and patents' monopolies restrict access to genetic tests such as Myriad's.
patent.translationZh: 批评者对基因专利提出了三个主要反对理由：基因是自然产物，因此不应被授予专利；基因专利会抑制而非奖励创新；专利垄断会限制人们获取像Myriad公司这样的基因检测服务。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

patent.sentenceEn: The BIO recently held a convention which included sessions to coach lawyers on the shifting landscape for patents .
patent.translationZh: 生物技术行业组织（BIO）最近召开了一次大会，其中包括专门培训律师应对不断变化的专利环境的研讨会。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

patent.sentenceEn: Companies are eager to win patents for "connecting the dots," explains Hans Sauer, a lawyer for the BIO.
patent.translationZh: 生物技术行业组织（BIO）的律师汉斯·绍尔解释道，各公司正急于为这种“关联分析”申请专利。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

patent.sentenceEn: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
patent.translationZh: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的判决，裁定Myriad Genetics公司确实可以拥有两项基因的专利，这两项基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

patent.sentenceEn: Companies had won patents for isolated DNA for decades – by 2005 some 20% of human genes were patented .
patent.translationZh: 数十年来，各家公司一直拥有分离DNA的专利——截至2005年，约20%的人类基因已获得专利。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

patent.sentenceEn: Last year a federal task-force urged reform for patents related to genetic tests.
patent.translationZh: 去年，一个联邦特别工作组敦促对基因检测相关专利进行改革。
patent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

profit.sentenceEn: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
profit.translationZh: 自从开始与网飞公司(Netflix Inc.)在其主场展开竞争以来，传统好莱坞在流媒体业务上一直难以实现盈利。迪士尼+、孔雀(Peacock)和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们的担忧：这些流媒体服务可能永远无法像有线电视曾经那样盈利。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

profit.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
profit.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

profit.sentenceEn: By cutting out the middlemen, the farmers secure more profit for their produce.
profit.translationZh: 通过省去中间商环节，农民们能为自己的农产品获得更多利润。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

profit.sentenceEn: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals.
profit.translationZh: 奇怪的是，编辑理应效力的期刊根本没有从中获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

profit.sentenceEn: Here's a common scenario that any number of entrepreneurs face today: you're the CEO of a small business, and though you're making a nice profit , you need to find a way to take it to the next level.
profit.translationZh: 以下是当今众多创业者共同面临的一种常见情况：你是一家小型企业的首席执行官，尽管企业盈利可观，但你需要找到方法将其提升到一个新的水平。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

profit.sentenceEn: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
profit.translationZh: 荷兰出版巨头爱思唯尔(Elsevier)声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年利润超过9亿英镑；而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，以使研究人员能够获取他们自己的公共资助研究成果。尽管人们愈发迫切地试图改变这种局面，但这两个数字似乎都在持续上涨，势不可挡。
profit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

particularly.sentenceEn: "Yet the combined consequences of suppression and climate change have eroded humanity's ability to suppress fires, particularly those that ignite under the most dangerous weather conditions."
particularly.translationZh: 然而，森林防火抑制与气候变化的双重影响，削弱了人类扑灭山火的能力，尤其是那些在极端恶劣天气条件下诱发的火灾。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

particularly.sentenceEn: His pictures of a Glanville fritillary rising from the sea-pinks beside the chalk cliffs of Compton Bay on the Isle of Wight are particularly glorious.
particularly.translationZh: 他拍摄的格兰维尔豹纹蝶从怀特岛康普顿湾白垩悬崖旁的海石竹中振翅而起的照片尤为壮丽。

particularly.sentenceEn: But that's a very shortsighted view, particularly when it comes to the Chesapeake Bay.
particularly.translationZh: 但这种观点非常短视，尤其是对于切萨皮克湾而言。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

particularly.sentenceEn: Particularly useful in busy locations or during times of emergency, the doors act as crowd management by reducing the obstacles put in people's way.
particularly.translationZh: 在繁忙场所或紧急情况下，自动门尤为实用，它们通过减少行人通行障碍来辅助人群疏导。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

particularly.sentenceEn: New AI technologies are particularly concentrated: Brookings's Mark Muro and Sifan Liu estimate that just 15 cities account for two-thirds of the AI assets and capabilities in the United States.
particularly.translationZh: 新的人工智能技术集中度尤其高：布鲁金斯学会的马克·穆罗和刘思凡估计，仅15个城市就占据了美国三分之二的人工智能资产和能力。
particularly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

particularly.sentenceEn: "The visualization, particularly those photographs, really hit home that this is something that has to be protected," says Alicia Murphy, Yellowstone's park historian.
particularly.translationZh: 黄石国家公园历史学家艾丽西亚·墨菲表示：“这些可视化作品，尤其是那些照片，真正让人们深刻认识到这是一个必须加以保护的地方。”

performance.sentenceEn: The performance was a creative call to action ahead of November's United Nations Climate Change Conference in Glasgow, UK.
performance.translationZh: 这场演出是在11月英国格拉斯哥联合国气候变化大会召开前发出的富有创意的行动号召。
performance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

performance.sentenceEn: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance .
performance.translationZh: 正如无数董事会和企业主所证实的那样，限制企业解雇表现不佳的高薪管理人员，会严重阻碍企业提高生产力和整体绩效。
performance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

performance.sentenceEn: Use of their gut hurt their performance on the first four tasks, as expected, and helped them on the rest.
performance.translationZh: 正如预期的那样，依靠直觉会降低他们在前四项任务中的表现，但会帮助他们完成其余任务。
performance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

performance.sentenceEn: Britain's new rule is a reminder to bankers that society has an interest in their performance , not just for the short term but for the long term.
performance.translationZh: 英国的新规提醒银行家们，社会关注的是他们的业绩表现，不仅是短期的，更是长期的。
performance.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

performance.sentenceEn: In the US, the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002 has pushed most public companies to defer performance bonuses for senior executives by about a year, slightly helping reduce "short-termism."
