previous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

previous.sentenceEn: A butterfly takes off so quickly it is still impossible to react quickly enough to capture that take-off but if he half-presses the shutter, the camera saves the 70 previous frames before the moment he actually takes the picture.
previous.translationZh: 蝴蝶起飞速度极快，快到让人来不及反应捕捉这一起飞瞬间，但如果他半按快门，相机就会保存他实际拍照前的70帧画面。

previous.sentenceEn: Researchers analysed the frequency and impact of gaps greater than 2 seconds during conversations, including an overview of previous studies which indicate that the fear of awkward silences can be so extreme that people avoid talking to strangers, even though doing so is likely to be an enjoyable experience.
previous.translationZh: 研究人员分析了对话中超过2秒的停顿频率及其影响，包括对先前研究的综述。这些研究表明，人们对尴尬沉默的恐惧可能非常强烈，以至于会避免与陌生人交谈，尽管这样的交谈很可能是一次愉快的体验。
previous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

previous.sentenceEn: One previous study looked at the Efé people of the Democratic Republic of Congo.
previous.translationZh: 此前有一项研究关注了刚果民主共和国的埃费族人。
previous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

previous.sentenceEn: While veterans of previous expeditions had written at length about stunning sights, these vivid photographs were another thing entirely.
previous.translationZh: 虽然先前探险队的老兵们曾详细描述过那些令人惊叹的景观，但这些生动的照片却完全是另一回事。

previous.sentenceEn: Any plans submitted before that date are considered to be under the previous rules, and can go ahead as long as work starts before 15 June next year.
previous.translationZh: 任何在该日期前提交的规划申请均按旧规处理，只要在明年6月15日前开工即可推进。
previous.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

publisher.sentenceEn: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher , Simon & Schuster—the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
publisher.translationZh: 这一切发生之际，作者们本已在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一家大型出版商西蒙与舒斯特出版社拟议合并可能带来的后果——英国独立出版商数量的减少可能会导致竞价竞争减少、预付款降低，以及出版内容更趋同质化。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

publisher.sentenceEn: We shall see whether that plurality is a casualty of the current need among publishers to be big enough to take on all-comers.
publisher.translationZh: 我们将拭目以待，这种多元性是否会成为当下出版商追求规模以应对各方竞争这一需求的牺牲品。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

publisher.sentenceEn: After all, many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers .
publisher.translationZh: 毕竟，近年来许多最有意思的书籍都出自小型出版社。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

publisher.sentenceEn: With the content of papers secured for free, the publisher needs only find a market for its journal.
publisher.translationZh: 论文内容已免费获取，出版商只需为其期刊寻找市场即可。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

publisher.sentenceEn: More than half of all British scientific research is now published under open access terms: either freely available from the moment of publication, or paywalled for a year or more so that the publishers can make a profit before being placed on general release.
publisher.translationZh: 目前，超过半数的英国科学研究成果是在开放获取条款下发表的：要么自发表之日起即可免费获取，要么设置一年或更长时间的付费墙，以便出版商在全面公开前获取利润。
publisher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

publisher.sentenceEn: Big publishers will lose their dominance.
publisher.translationZh: 大型出版社会失去其主导地位。

payment.sentenceEn: The prevalence of digital payment devices has made it easier to ask customers for a tip.
payment.translationZh: 数字支付设备的普及使得向顾客索要小费变得更加容易。
payment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

payment.sentenceEn: In the early 2010s, a wide range of businesses started processing purchases with iPads and other digital payment systems.
payment.translationZh: 2010年代初期，各类企业开始使用iPad和其他数字支付系统处理交易。
payment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

payment.sentenceEn: The problem with being a grownup is that there's an awful lot of serious stuff to deal with – work, mortgage payments , figuring out what to cook for dinner.
payment.translationZh: 成年人的问题在于，我们有太多严肃的事情要处理——工作、房贷、琢磨晚餐做什么。
payment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

payment.sentenceEn: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."
payment.translationZh: 即便现在工作稳定了，他仍表示：“我自己还是无力承担每月的房贷，所以不得不把房间租出去来维持还款。”
payment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

payment.sentenceEn: The principle of British welfare is no longer that you can insure yourself against the risk of unemployment and receive unconditional payments if the disaster happens.
payment.translationZh: 英国福利制度的原则已不再是，你可以为自己投保以应对失业风险，并在不幸发生时获得无条件的救济金。
payment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

payment.sentenceEn: The fact that this is not an uncommon occurrence means that dishonest persons might be able to access bank accounts in electronic payments systems and steal from someone else's accounts.
payment.translationZh: 这种情况并不罕见，这意味着不诚实的人可能会入侵电子支付系统中的银行账户，盗取他人账户资金。
payment.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

principle.sentenceEn: The development in 1915 of the popular new subject "general science" was another effort to train students to apply the principles of science to everyday, nonscience problems.
principle.translationZh: 1915年，广受欢迎的新学科“综合科学”得到发展，这是培养学生将科学原理应用于日常非科学问题的又一次尝试。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

principle.sentenceEn: Although these methods differ, the main principles remain the same.
principle.translationZh: 尽管这些方法各不相同，但其主要原理保持一致。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

principle.sentenceEn: On the basis of the precautionary principle , it could be argued that it is advisable to follow the FSA advice.
principle.translationZh: 基于预防原则，可以认为遵循英国食品标准局的建议是明智的。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

principle.sentenceEn: More education is the new principle .
principle.translationZh: 接受更多教育成了新的准则。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

principle.sentenceEn: As so often is the case, stating that principle doesn't ease the challenge of line-drawing.
principle.translationZh: 通常情况下，阐明这一原则并不能简化界定界限的挑战。
principle.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

principle.sentenceEn: By using the first draft as a means of thinking about what you want to say, you will very likely discover more than your notes originally suggested. Plenty of good writers don't use outlines at all but discover ordering principles as they write. Do not attempt to compose a perfectly correct draft the first time around.
principle.translationZh: 将初稿作为思考表达内容的工具，你很可能会发现比笔记中原先记录的更多东西。许多优秀作家完全不使用提纲，而是在写作过程中发现文章的组织结构。不要试图在第一次就写出完美无误的草稿。
principle.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

powerful.sentenceEn: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
powerful.translationZh: 这种合作方式既能催生新的研究，也能孕育出富有感染力的艺术作品。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

powerful.sentenceEn: Before you share your thoughts, think about what the powerful person cares about—it may be the credibility of their team or getting a project done on time.
powerful.translationZh: 在表达你的想法之前，先思考这位上级关心什么——可能是团队的信誉，或是项目能否按时完成。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

powerful.sentenceEn: Discussing the issue in private will make the powerful person feel less threatened.
powerful.translationZh: 私下讨论这个问题会让位高权重者感觉威胁较小。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第6句

powerful.sentenceEn: This step may sound overly deferential, but it's a smart way to give the powerful person psychological safety and control.
powerful.translationZh: 这一步骤听起来可能过于恭顺，但却是给予权势者心理安全感和掌控感的明智之举。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

powerful.sentenceEn: Here's how to disagree with someone more powerful than you.
powerful.translationZh: 以下是如何向上级表达不同意见的方法。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

powerful.sentenceEn: But Mauna Kea is also home to some of the world's most powerful telescopes.
powerful.translationZh: 但莫纳克亚山也是世界上一些最强大望远镜的所在地。
powerful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

pain.sentenceEn: Neuroscientists have been at pains to demonstrate that the pleasure a book provides isn't indulgence; it's good for you.
pain.translationZh: 神经科学家一直致力于证明，阅读书籍带来的愉悦感并非一种放纵，而是大有裨益。

pain.sentenceEn: Plants can't run away from danger, so investing energy in a body system which recognizes a threat and can feel pain would be a very poor evolutionary strategy, according to the article.
pain.translationZh: 文章指出，植物无法逃离危险，因此将能量投入到一个能够识别威胁并感知疼痛的身体系统中，将是一种非常糟糕的进化策略。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

pain.sentenceEn: And stay alert to serious symptoms, such as chest pain or pressure, severe shortness of breath or dizziness, or faintness, and seek medical attention immediately.
pain.translationZh: 同时要警惕严重症状，如胸痛或胸部压迫感、严重呼吸急促、头晕或晕厥，一旦出现应立即就医。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

pain.sentenceEn: Mental health allows us to view others with sympathy if they are having troubles, with kindness if they are in pain , and with unconditional love no matter who they are.
pain.translationZh: 心理健康使我们在他人陷入困境时心怀同情，在他人遭受痛苦时给予善意，无论对方是谁，都能付出无条件的爱。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

pain.sentenceEn: This could be no more than a passing literary craze, but it also points to a broader truth about how we now approach the past: less concerned with learning from our forefathers and more interested in feeling their pain .
pain.translationZh: 这或许只是一时的文学热潮，但它也揭示了一个更广泛的真相——我们如今看待过去的方式：不再那么关注从先辈那里学习，而是更感兴趣于感受他们的痛苦。
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

pain.sentenceEn: But what we forget – what our economy depends on us forgetting – is that happiness is more than pleasure without pain .
pain.translationZh: 但我们忘记了——我们的经济就依赖于我们对此的遗忘——幸福远不止是没有痛苦的快乐。
pain.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
pain.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

participant.sentenceEn: Half of the participants were told the information would be erased, while the other half were told it would be saved.
participant.translationZh: 一半的参与者被告知信息将会被删除，而另一半则被告知信息会被保存。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

participant.sentenceEn: The participants filled out questionnaires about how often they did things that were altruistic and positive, like sacrificing their own interests to help a friend, or rebellious and negative, like getting drunk or staying out late.
participant.translationZh: 参与者填写了调查问卷，内容涉及他们做出利他和积极行为的频率，例如牺牲个人利益帮助朋友，以及叛逆和消极行为的频率，例如酗酒或深夜不归。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

participant.sentenceEn: And surfing the web exercised the brain more than reading did among computer-savvy older adults in a 2008 study involving 24 participants at the Semel Institute for Neuroscience and Human Behavior at the University of California, Los Angeles.
participant.translationZh: 2008年，加州大学洛杉矶分校塞梅尔神经科学与人类行为研究所开展了一项涉及24名参与者的研究，结果显示，在精通电脑的老年人中，上网冲浪比阅读更能锻炼大脑。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

participant.sentenceEn: In 2011, Sparrow led a study in which participants were asked to record 40 factoids in a computer ("an ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain," for example).
participant.translationZh: 2011年，斯派洛主导了一项研究，参与者被要求在电脑中记录40条趣闻知识（例如，“鸵鸟的眼睛比它的大脑还大”）。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

participant.sentenceEn: The reach of art-science tie-ups needs to go beyond the necessary purpose of research communication, and participants must not fall into the trap of stereotyping each other.
participant.translationZh: 艺术与科学合作的影响范围需要超越研究传播这一必要目的，并且参与者不应陷入对彼此产生刻板印象的误区。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

participant.sentenceEn: On average, participants who followed this instruction felt better than those who had been told to stand or sit in silence.
participant.translationZh: 平均而言，遵循这一指示的参与者比那些被要求安静站立或坐着的参与者感觉更好。
participant.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

politics.sentenceEn: His status in Lord Wellington's headquarters and the recognition given to him for his work were all bound up with the class politics of the army at the time.
politics.translationZh: 他在威灵顿勋爵总部的地位以及因其工作所获得的认可，都与当时军队中的阶级政治紧密相连。
politics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

politics.sentenceEn: This kind of thinking is why so many people try to avoid arguments, especially about politics and religion.
politics.translationZh: 正是这种思维方式导致许多人试图避免争论，尤其是关于政治和宗教的争论。

politics.sentenceEn: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics .
politics.translationZh: 从职业发展到社区生活再到家庭观念，这些差异表明，在灼痛人心的"大衰退"之后，那些刚刚踏入社会的年轻人正在确立自己的优先事项和期望，而这些观念将逐渐渗透到美国生活的方方面面，从消费偏好到住房模式，再到政治取向。
politics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

politics.sentenceEn: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
politics.translationZh: 正是这种对政治的明显超越性，解释了君主作为国家元首为何能持续受到欢迎。
politics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

politics.sentenceEn: When public opinion is particularly polarised, as it was following the end of the Franco regime, monarchs can rise above "mere" politics and "embody" a spirit of national unity.
politics.translationZh: 当公众舆论出现严重两极分化时——正如佛朗哥政权结束后的情况那样——君主能够超越"纯粹的"政治，"体现"国家统一的精神。
politics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

politics.sentenceEn: He was not interested in daily politics , but concerned with questions of moral behavior and the larger questions of right and wrong affecting the entire society.
politics.translationZh: 他对日常政治不感兴趣，而是关注道德行为问题以及影响整个社会的更大层面的是非问题。
politics.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

propose.sentenceEn: Pat Hardy, who sympathises with the views of the energy sector, is resisting proposed changes to science standards for pre-teen pupils.
propose.translationZh: 帕特·哈迪（Pat Hardy）对能源行业的观点持同情态度，她正抵制针对青春期前学生科学课程标准的拟议修改。
propose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

propose.sentenceEn: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster—the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
propose.translationZh: 这一切发生之际，作者们本已在担忧企鹅兰登书屋与另一家大型出版商西蒙与舒斯特出版社拟议合并可能带来的后果——英国独立出版商数量的减少可能会导致竞价竞争减少、预付款降低，以及出版内容更趋同质化。
propose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

propose.sentenceEn: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
propose.translationZh: 然而，该法案提出的机制过于繁琐，并且在当年晚些时候政府更迭后被否决。
propose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第3句

propose.sentenceEn: Your boss proposes a new initiative you think won't work.
propose.translationZh: 你的老板提出了一项你认为行不通的新举措。
propose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

propose.sentenceEn: In order to ensure that elite women have more such opportunities, they have proposed imposing government quotas.
propose.translationZh: 为了确保精英女性获得更多此类机会，他们提议实施政府配额制度。
propose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

propose.sentenceEn: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions.
propose.translationZh: 相反，数字服务税是一个更广泛趋势的一部分。过去几年，各国纷纷提出或实施各种以字母缩写命名的新型国际税收条款，种类繁多，令人眼花缭乱。
propose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

perceive.sentenceEn: The intense focus on scientific literacy in the United States originally grew out of the critical role of science and technology during World War II, as well as the perceived deficiencies of American soldiers.
perceive.translationZh: 美国对科学素养的高度关注，最初源于科学技术在第二次世界大战期间所发挥的关键作用，以及当时人们所察觉到的美国士兵在相关素质上的不足。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

perceive.sentenceEn: Whether we opt for bold, colorful outfits or prefer more understated styles, our dress choices convey messages about who we are and how we want to be perceived .
perceive.translationZh: 无论我们选择大胆鲜艳的装扮，还是倾向于低调内敛的风格，我们的着装都在传递信息，展现我们的个性以及我们希望在他人眼中的形象。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

perceive.sentenceEn: And while you might fear coming across as incompetent, there's actually research that shows that advice-seekers are perceived as more competent, not less.
perceive.translationZh: 虽然你可能担心自己会显得无能，但实际上有研究表明，寻求建议的人往往被认为更有能力，而非相反。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

perceive.sentenceEn: Instead, says Coyle, resentment is simmering among many as the benefits are perceived to go to elites in a handful of prosperous cities.
perceive.translationZh: 相反，科伊尔指出，由于人们认为科技带来的好处都流向了少数繁华城市的精英阶层，许多人心中的不满正在悄然升温。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

perceive.sentenceEn: The scientific community measures the quality of those papers in a number of ways, including the perceived quality of the journal (as reflected by the title's impact factor) and the number of citations a specific paper accumulates.
perceive.translationZh: 科学界通过多种方式衡量这些论文的质量，包括期刊的公认质量（体现在该刊的影响因子上）以及特定论文积累的引用次数。
perceive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

perceive.sentenceEn: Rather, we ascribe meanings to texts on the basis of interaction between what we might call textual and contextual material: between kinds of organization or patterning we perceive in a text's formal structures (so especially its language structures) and various kinds of background, social knowledge, belief and attitude that we bring to the text.
perceive.translationZh: 相反，我们赋予文本意义是基于我们所谓的文本材料与语境材料之间的互动：一方面是我们在文本形式结构（尤其是语言结构）中感知到的各种组织方式或模式，另一方面是我们带入文本的各种背景知识、社会认知、信念和态度。

perform.sentenceEn: It is closely related to song and even when written it is usually created to be performed out loud.
perform.translationZh: 诗歌与歌曲渊源深厚，即便被书写成文，也通常是为了能够被大声吟诵而创作的。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

perform.sentenceEn: As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing , high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance.
perform.translationZh: 正如无数董事会和企业主所证实的那样，限制企业解雇表现不佳的高薪管理人员，会严重阻碍企业提高生产力和整体绩效。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

perform.sentenceEn: One example of how artists and scientists have together rocked the scenes came last month when the Sydney Symphony Orchestra performed a reworked version of Antonio Vivaldi's The Four Seasons.
perform.translationZh: 上个月，悉尼交响乐团演奏了安东尼奥·维瓦尔第《四季》的改编版本，这正是艺术家与科学家携手共创精彩的一个范例。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

perform.sentenceEn: The thought of holding a fixed grin as the camera performed its magical duties was too much to contemplate, and so a non-committal blank stare became the norm.
perform.translationZh: 想想看，在相机履行其神奇使命的过程中要一直保持固定的笑容，这简直让人难以忍受，因此一种不置可否的茫然凝视便成了常态。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

perform.sentenceEn: Other scientists perform the specialised work of peer review also for free, because it is a central element in the acquisition of status and the production of scientific knowledge.
perform.translationZh: 其他科学家也免费从事专业的同行评审工作，因为这是获取学术地位和产出科学知识的核心要素。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

perform.sentenceEn: These new forms were at first mainly written by scholars and performed by amateurs, but in England, as everywhere else in western Europe, the growth of a class of professional actors was threatening to make the drama popular, whether it should be new or old, classical or medieval, literary or farcical.
perform.translationZh: 这些新形式最初主要由学者创作，由业余爱好者表演，但在英国，如同西欧其他各地一样，职业演员阶层的兴起正推动戏剧走向大众化，无论其是新是旧、古典还是中世纪、文学性还是滑稽性。
perform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: A Reddit webpage devoted to the phenomenon , boasting nearly 50,000 members, showcases images of local desire paths adorned with signs instructing pedestrians to adhere to designated walkways, underscoring the rebellious nature inherent in these human-made tracks.
phenomenon.translationZh: Reddit上有一个专门讨论这一现象的网页，拥有近5万名成员。该网页展示了各种本地“欲望小径”的图片，这些小径旁往往立着指示行人走指定步道的标牌，凸显了这些人为路径中固有的叛逆性质。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: Writing in The New Republic, Alice Lee notes that increasing the number of opportunities for board membership without increasing the pool of qualified women to serve on such boards has led to a "golden skirt" phenomenon , where the same elite women scoop up multiple seats on a variety of boards.
phenomenon.translationZh: 艾丽斯·李在《新共和》杂志中指出，在没有扩大合格女性人才库的情况下增加董事会席位机会，已经导致了一种"金裙现象"——即同一位精英女性在多家不同的董事会中占据多个席位。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第1句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: A survey by Barna research group found the top reason given by Americans for the fake news phenomenon is "reader error," more so than made-up stories or factual mistakes in reporting.
phenomenon.translationZh: 巴纳研究集团的一项调查发现，美国人认为虚假新闻现象的首要原因是“读者错误”，这一因素超过了虚构故事或报道中的事实错误。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: The Parkrun phenomenon began with a dozen friends and has inspired 400 events in the UK and more abroad.
phenomenon.translationZh: 公园跑这一现象最初由十几位朋友发起，如今已在英国催生了400场活动，在国外的活动更多。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: Since technology has such an insatiable appetite for eating up human jobs, this phenomenon will continue to restructure our economy in ways we cannot immediately foresee.
phenomenon.translationZh: 由于技术对吞噬人类工作岗位的欲望永无止境，这种现象将继续以我们无法立即预见的方式重塑我们的经济。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

phenomenon.sentenceEn: The concept of man versus machine is at least as old as the industrial revolution, but this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries.
phenomenon.translationZh: 人机对抗这一概念至少可以追溯到工业革命时期，但这种现象在经济下行和复苏乏力时期往往表现得最为尖锐。
phenomenon.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

presence.sentenceEn: The review recommends a national branding campaign to give libraries a stronger physical presence , the reintroduction of a scheme to enable members to use their card in any library in the country, and automatic memberships for children.
presence.translationZh: 该审查报告建议发起一项全国性的品牌宣传活动，以增强图书馆的实体感；重新推行一项让会员持卡即可使用全国任一图书馆的计划；以及为儿童自动办理入会手续。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

presence.sentenceEn: They have included Britain's DPT. (diverted profits tax), Australia's MAAL (multinational anti-avoidance law), and India's SEP (significant economic presence ) test, to name but a few.
presence.translationZh: 其中包括英国的DPT（转移利润税）、澳大利亚的MAAL（跨国反避税法）以及印度的SEP（显著经济存在）测试，仅举几例。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

presence.sentenceEn: "Each year the physical presence rule becomes further removed from economic reality and results in significant revenue losses to the States," he wrote in an opinion joined by four other justices.
presence.translationZh: 他在一份有另外四位大法官联署的意见书中写道：“实体存在规则每年都愈发脱离经济现实，给各州造成了重大的收入损失。”
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

presence.sentenceEn: The ruling is a victory for big chains with a presence in many states, since they usually collect sales tax on online purchases already.
presence.translationZh: 这项裁决对在多州设有实体门店的大型连锁企业来说是一场胜利，因为它们通常已经对在线购物征收销售税。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

presence.sentenceEn: Until now, many sellers that have a physical presence in only a single state or a few states have been able to avoid charging sales taxes when they ship to addresses outside those states.
presence.translationZh: 在此之前，许多仅在单个州或少数几个州设有实体经营场所的卖家，在向这些州以外的地址发货时，一直能够免缴销售税。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

presence.sentenceEn: The cases the court overturned said that if a business was shipping a customer's purchase to a state where the business didn't have a physical presence such as a warehouse or office, the business didn't have to collect sales tax for the state.
presence.translationZh: 法院推翻的这些案件判决称，如果企业将客户购买的商品运送到该企业没有实体存在（如仓库或办公室）的州，则该企业不必为该州征收销售税。
presence.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

psychologist.sentenceEn: In both examples — and others that we all experience — there's another process at work that psychologists call mind reading.
psychologist.translationZh: 在这两个例子（以及我们都会经历的其他例子）中，还有另一种被称为“读心术”的心理学过程在发挥作用。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

psychologist.sentenceEn: Psychologists have a term for this way of thinking: personalisation.
psychologist.translationZh: 心理学家将这种思维方式称为“个人化”。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

psychologist.sentenceEn: Psychologists have been interested in this question for decades, not least because people's widespread reluctance to ask for help has led to some high-profile failures.
psychologist.translationZh: 心理学家对这个问题的研究已有数十年之久，尤其是因为人们普遍不愿寻求帮助，这已导致了一些备受瞩目的失败案例。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

psychologist.sentenceEn: There is no experimental evidence showing that it interferes with our ability to focus, for instance, wrote psychologists Christopher Chabris and Daniel J. Simons.
psychologist.translationZh: 例如，心理学家克里斯托弗·查布里斯(Christopher Chabris)和丹尼尔·J·西蒙斯(Daniel J. Simons)写道，目前尚无实验证据表明互联网会干扰我们的专注力。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

psychologist.sentenceEn: Psychologist Nina Strohminger at the University of Pennsylvania, who was not involved in the study, says she wants the effect to be real but cannot rule out some unknown confounding variable.
psychologist.translationZh: 宾夕法尼亚大学的心理学家尼娜·斯特罗明格并未参与这项研究，她说她希望这种效果是真实的，但不能排除一些未知的混淆变量。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

psychologist.sentenceEn: In one study of the ability she called "thin slicing," the late psychologist Nalini Ambady asked participants to watch silent 10-second video clips of professors and to rate the instructor's overall effectiveness.
psychologist.translationZh: 在一项关于她称之为“薄片撷取”能力的研究中，已故心理学家纳利尼·安巴迪让参与者观看教授们10秒钟的无声视频片段，并对讲师的整体教学效果进行评分。
psychologist.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

procedure.sentenceEn: For instance, as convenient and provocative, AI enables virtual try-on experiences where you can virtually test makeup, hairstyles, clothing, and even cosmetic procedures before making any physical changes.
procedure.translationZh: 例如，人工智能提供了既便捷又具启发性的体验，让你在进行任何实际改变之前，能够虚拟尝试化妆、发型、服装，甚至美容整形手术。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

procedure.sentenceEn: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures .
procedure.translationZh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

procedure.sentenceEn: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from "unjustified dismissals".
procedure.translationZh: 个人申诉程序旨在保护普通工人的工作免遭“不当解雇”。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

procedure.sentenceEn: Americans are willing to tolerate time-consuming security procedures in return for increased safety.
procedure.translationZh: 为了提升安全保障，美国人愿意忍受耗时的安检程序。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

procedure.sentenceEn: The Taylor decision also declared sex discrimination in jury selection to be unconstitutional and ordered states to use the same procedures for selecting male and female jurors.
procedure.translationZh: 泰勒案的判决还宣布在陪审团遴选中存在性别歧视是违宪的，并命令各州在遴选男性和女性陪审员时采用相同的程序。
procedure.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

procedure.sentenceEn: What might be an effect of ERA's unjustified dismissal procedures ?
procedure.translationZh: 《雇佣关系法》中关于不当解雇的条款可能会产生什么影响？

profession.sentenceEn: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession ."
profession.translationZh: 如果这听起来有些夸大其词，请考虑这样一个事实：代表约 3000 名电影从业者的工会——美国艺术指导工会，已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发布声明称：“凭良心讲，我们无法鼓励你们从事这一职业。”
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

profession.sentenceEn: There are groups aimed at new parents, at those who want to try a new sport for the first time, or networking events for those in the same profession to meet up and share ideas.
profession.translationZh: 有专门面向新手父母的团体，有供初次尝试新运动的人参与的群体，也有供同行相聚交流想法的社交活动。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

profession.sentenceEn: Part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe is that the difficulties are addressed piecemeal by different professions with different focuses, including gerontologists, highway administration officials, automotive engineers and others, said gerontologist Elizabeth Dugan.
profession.translationZh: 老年病学家伊丽莎白·杜根表示，保障老年驾驶员安全面临的部分问题在于，不同专业领域的人士各有侧重，各自零散地应对这些难题，其中包括老年病学家、公路管理部门官员、汽车工程师等。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

profession.sentenceEn: After all, other countries, such as Australia and Britain, have started liberalizing their legal professions .
profession.translationZh: 毕竟，其他国家，如澳大利亚和英国，已经开始对其法律行业实行自由化改革。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

profession.sentenceEn: There is pressure for change from within the profession , but opponents of change among the regulators insist that keeping outsiders out of a law firm isolates lawyers from the pressure to make money rather than serve clients ethically.
profession.translationZh: 法律行业内部存在要求变革的压力，但监管机构中的反对变革者坚持认为，不让外部人士涉足律师事务所，可以使律师免受只顾赚钱而不是以道德方式为客户服务的压力。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

profession.sentenceEn: All around the world, lawyers generate more hostility than the members of any other profession – with the possible exception of journalism.
profession.translationZh: 在全世界范围内，律师比其他任何职业的从业者都更易招致敌意——新闻业或许是个例外。
profession.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

pace.sentenceEn: Last year marked the third year in a row that Indonesia's bleak rate of deforestation has slowed in pace .
pace.translationZh: 去年是印度尼西亚严峻的森林砍伐率连续第三年放缓。
pace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

pace.sentenceEn: Simply slowing the pace and talking in an even tone helps the other person cool down and does the same for you.
pace.translationZh: 只需放慢语速，用平稳的语调说话，就能帮助对方冷静下来，同时也能让自己平静。
pace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第6句

pace.sentenceEn: With the global population predicted to hit close to 10 billion by 2050, and forecasts that agricultural production in some regions will need to nearly double to keep pace , food security is increasingly making headlines.
pace.translationZh: 预计到2050年全球人口将接近100亿，而据预测，部分地区的农业产量需接近翻倍才能跟上这一增长步伐，粮食安全问题因此日益成为新闻焦点。
pace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

pace.sentenceEn: The pace of change in energy sources appears to be speeding up – perhaps just in time to have a meaningful effect in slowing climate change.
pace.translationZh: 能源来源的变革速度似乎正在加快——这或许恰逢其时，能对减缓气候变化产生积极影响。
pace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

pace.sentenceEn: For one thing, it is very slow compared to the pace of change within the digital economy.
pace.translationZh: 一方面，相较于数字经济的变革速度，它的进程过于缓慢。
pace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

pace.sentenceEn: Young people who are still getting started in life were more likely than older adults to prioritize personal fulfillment in their work, to believe they will advance their careers most by regularly changing jobs, to favor communities with more public services and a faster pace of life, to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children, and to maintain that children are best served by two parents working outside the home, the survey found.
pace.translationZh: 调查发现，与年长一代相比，那些人生刚刚起步的年轻人更倾向于将工作中的个人成就感放在首位，认为定期跳槽最有助于职业发展，偏爱公共服务更完善、生活节奏更快的社区，认同夫妻应在经济稳定后再结婚生子，并且认为父母双方都外出工作最有利于孩子成长。
pace.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

phrase.sentenceEn: It wasn't until the phrase "scientific literacy" came along in the 1940s that science had the formidable slogan it needed to command public attention and make improving science education an important national goal.
phrase.translationZh: 直到 20 世纪 40 年代出现了“科学素养”一词，科学界才拥有了所需的强有力口号，用以吸引公众注意力，并将提升科学教育水平转变为一项重要的国家目标。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

phrase.sentenceEn: Through carefully selected words and phrases , poems can be dramatic, funny, beautiful, moving and inspiring.
phrase.translationZh: 通过精心挑选的词语和短语，诗歌可以充满戏剧性、幽默风趣、优美动人、感人肺腑且鼓舞人心。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

phrase.sentenceEn: Such actions to seek knowledge and to understand what information we already knew were captured by the Latin phrase 'sapere aude' or 'dare to know', after Immanuel Kant used it in his essay "An Answer to the Question: What is Enlightenment?"
phrase.translationZh: 这种追求知识和理解已知信息的行为被拉丁语短语'sapere aude'（意为'敢于求知'）所概括，这个短语因伊曼努尔·康德在其论文《答复这个问题：什么是启蒙运动？》中使用而广为人知。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

phrase.sentenceEn: Even the very phrase "jobseeker's allowance" is about redefining the unemployed as a "jobseeker" who had no fundamental right to a benefit he or she has earned through making national insurance contributions.
phrase.translationZh: 就连"求职者津贴"这一说法本身就在重新定义失业者——将其定义为一名"求职者"，而这名求职者根本无权享有他或她通过缴纳国民保险费所应得的福利。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

phrase.sentenceEn: One of these urges has to do with creating a state of peace in the midst of turbulence, a "still point of the turning world," to borrow a phrase from T. S. Eliot.
phrase.translationZh: 这些渴望之一与在动荡中创造一种宁静状态有关，借用T.S.艾略特的话来说，就是一个“旋转世界的静止点”。
phrase.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

phrase.sentenceEn: What does the phrase "to be aligned" (Line 5, Para. 6) most probably mean?
phrase.translationZh: 短语“to be aligned”（第六段第五行）最可能的含义是什么？

press.sentenceEn: The Gutenberg printing press transformed civilisation not by changing the nature of writing but by changing its cost—and it would have achieved little without a parallel collapse in the price of surfaces to write on, thanks to an often-overlooked technology called paper.
press.translationZh: 古腾堡印刷机改变了文明，并非通过改变书写的本质，而是通过改变其成本——如果没有另一种常被忽视的技术（即纸张）导致书写载体价格的同步暴跌，印刷机也难以取得多大成就。
press.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

press.sentenceEn: The really successful holders of such titles are those that do a great deal more than fill hotel bedrooms and bring in high-profile arts events and good press for a year.
press.translationZh: 真正成功的称号获得者所做的远不止于在一年内填满酒店客房、举办引人注目的艺术活动以及获得媒体的正面报道。
press.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

press.sentenceEn: Next, the researchers trapped the robots in cages and gave the rats the opportunity to release them by pressing a lever.
press.translationZh: 接下来，研究人员将机器人关进笼子，并给老鼠们通过按压杠杆来释放它们的机会。
press.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

press.sentenceEn: There is a great deal of this kind of nonsense in the medical journals which, when taken up by broadcasters and the lay press , generates both health scares and short-lived dietary enthusiasms.
press.translationZh: 医学期刊中充斥着大量此类无稽之谈，当这些内容被广播机构和大众媒体采纳后，既引发健康恐慌，也催生短暂的饮食热潮。
press.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

press.sentenceEn: Dickens and his publishers simply pressed on with a new artist.
press.translationZh: 狄更斯和他的出版商们只是简单地换了一位新艺术家，继续推进创作。
继续要求进行更多研究
press.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

priority.sentenceEn: To make writing a priority , you'll have to sacrifice some of your day-to-day activities and some things you really enjoy.
priority.translationZh: 要将写作列为优先事项，你必须牺牲一些日常活动和一些你真正喜欢的事情。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

priority.sentenceEn: As Harlan Coben has suggested, it's a question of priorities .
priority.translationZh: 正如哈兰·科本所暗示的，这是一个优先级的问题。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: Harlan Coben believes that if you're a writer, you'll find the time; and that if you can't find the time, then writing isn't a priority and you're not a writer.
priority.translationZh: 哈兰·科本认为，如果你是一名作家，你总能找到时间写作；如果你找不到时间，那说明写作并非你的首要任务，你也就算不上是一名作家。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: It's important to acknowledge that the environment isn't everyone's priority – or even most people's.
priority.translationZh: 我们必须承认，环境并非每个人的首要关切——甚至也不是大多数人的。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

priority.sentenceEn: The Conservatives' planning reform explicitly gives rural development priority over conservation, even authorising "off-plan" building where local people might object.
priority.translationZh: 保守党的规划改革明确将农村开发置于环境保护之上，甚至批准在当地人可能反对的地方进行'计划外'建设。
priority.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

priority.translationZh: 流媒体平台改变了其战略重心。

provider.sentenceEn: Primary care providers have their hands full and may not be able to follow through with patients who have trouble driving because they can't turn their heads or remember where they are going—or have gotten shorter and haven't changed their seat settings sufficiently to reach car pedals easily.
provider.translationZh: 初级保健提供者已经忙得不可开交，可能无法跟进那些驾驶有困难的患者——这些患者要么无法转动头部，要么记不住要去哪里，要么因身形变矮而未能充分调整座椅设置，导致无法轻松够到汽车踏板。
provider.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

provider.sentenceEn: In one example, an individual—acting as author, editor, and consultant—was able to use at least 15 journals as citation providers to articles published by five scientists at three universities.
provider.translationZh: 举个例子，有个人身兼作者、编辑和顾问三职，竟然能利用至少15家期刊为三所大学的五位科学家发表的文章提供引用。
provider.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

provider.sentenceEn: That's why there has been such a strong demand for rules that would prevent broadband providers from picking winners and losers online, preserving the freedom and innovation that have been the lifeblood of the Internet.
provider.translationZh: 这正是人们强烈要求制定相关规则的原因——这些规则将阻止宽带服务商在网络上偏袒某些企业、打压另一些企业，从而维护作为互联网生命线的自由与创新精神。
provider.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

provider.sentenceEn: It needs to give the commission explicit authority once and for all to bar broadband providers from meddling in the traffic on their network and to create clear rules protecting openness and innovation online.
provider.translationZh: 国会需要一劳永逸地赋予联邦通信委员会明确的权力，以禁止宽带供应商干预其网络上的流量，并制定明确的规则来保护网络的开放性和创新性。
provider.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

provider.sentenceEn: The order also declared that state and local governments couldn't regulate broadband providers either.
provider.translationZh: 该命令还宣布，州和地方政府也不得监管宽带服务提供商。
provider.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

provider.sentenceEn: It fosters competition among citation providers .
provider.translationZh: 这助长了引文提供者之间的竞争。

popularity.sentenceEn: Other artists besides Rutkowski have been surprised by the apparent popularity of their work in text-to-image generators—and some are now fighting back.
popularity.translationZh: 除了鲁特科夫斯基之外，其他艺术家也对自己的作品在文本转图像生成器中意外走红感到惊讶——有些人现在开始反击了。
popularity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

popularity.sentenceEn: The popularity of these novels consolidated Dickens as a nationally and internationally celebrated man of letters.
popularity.translationZh: 这些小说的流行使狄更斯成为国内外闻名的文坛巨匠。

popularity.sentenceEn: It is this apparent transcendence of politics that explains monarchs' continuing popularity as heads of state.
popularity.translationZh: 正是这种对政治的明显超越性，解释了君主作为国家元首为何能持续受到欢迎。
popularity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

popularity.sentenceEn: But embarrassing scandals and the popularity of the republican left in the recent Euro-elections have forced him to eat his words and stand down.
popularity.translationZh: 但令人难堪的丑闻以及共和左翼在近期欧洲议会选举中的崛起，迫使他食言并退位。
popularity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

popularity.sentenceEn: The theory also seems to explain the sudden and unexpected popularity of certain looks, brands, or neighborhoods.
popularity.translationZh: 这一理论似乎也能解释某些时尚潮流、品牌或社区为何会突然意外地走红。
popularity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

popularity.sentenceEn: DNT is losing its popularity among consumers.
popularity.translationZh: DNT正在消费者中失去 popularity。

poverty.sentenceEn: Called conditional cash transfers or CCTs, these social assistance programs are designed to reduce inequality and break the cycle of poverty .
poverty.translationZh: 这类社会救助项目被称为有条件现金转移支付(CCTs)，旨在减少不平等现象并打破贫困循环。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

poverty.sentenceEn: In fact, poverty alleviation and environmental protection are often viewed as conflicting goals, says Paul Ferraro, an economist at Johns Hopkins University.
poverty.translationZh: 约翰·霍普金斯大学的经济学家保罗·费拉罗表示，事实上，减贫与环境保护往往被视为相互冲突的目标。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

poverty.sentenceEn: Even if this program didn't reduce poverty , Ferraro says, "the value of the avoided deforestation just for carbon dioxide emissions alone is more than the program costs."
poverty.translationZh: 费拉罗表示，即便该项目未能减轻贫困，"单是在减少二氧化碳排放方面，避免森林砍伐所产生的价值就已超过项目成本。"
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第4句

poverty.sentenceEn: That's because economic growth can be correlated with environmental degradation, while protecting the environment is sometimes correlated with greater poverty .
poverty.translationZh: 这是因为经济增长可能与环境退化相关联，而保护环境有时又与加剧贫困相关联。
poverty.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

poverty.sentenceEn: In contrast, suppose you give a reasonable argument: that full-time workers should not have to live in poverty .
poverty.translationZh: 相反，假设你提出一个合理的论点：全职工作者不应被迫生活在贫困中。

poverty.sentenceEn: The family's increasing poverty forced Dickens out of school at age 12 to work in Warren's Blacking Warehouse, a shoe-polish factory, where the other working boys mocked him as "the young gentleman."
poverty.translationZh: 家庭日益加剧的贫困迫使狄更斯在12岁时辍学，进入沃伦黑鞋油厂工作。在这家鞋油厂里，其他童工都嘲笑他是"小绅士"。

publishing.sentenceEn: The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
publishing.translationZh: 出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来实现知识交流、提供选择和展现不同声音。
publishing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

publishing.sentenceEn: The advent of electronic publishing and authors' need to find outlets for their papers resulted in thousands of new journals.
publishing.translationZh: 电子出版的出现以及作者为其论文寻找发表渠道的需求，催生了数千种新期刊。
publishing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

publishing.sentenceEn: Scientific publishing has long been a licence to print money.
publishing.translationZh: 长期以来，科学出版业一直是个一本万利的行业。
publishing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

publishing.sentenceEn: In some ways the scientific publishing model resembles the economy of the social internet: labour is provided free in exchange for the hope of status, while huge profits are made by a few big firms who run the market places.
publishing.translationZh: 在某些方面，科学出版模式与社交互联网经济颇为相似：人们免费提供劳动，以换取获得地位的希望，而少数运营着市场平台的大公司却赚取了巨额利润。
publishing.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第5句

publishing.sentenceEn: Which of the following characterizes the scientific publishing model?
publishing.translationZh: 以下哪项是科学出版模式的特征？

publishing.sentenceEn: The publishing industry is having a hard time.
publishing.translationZh: 出版行业正经历一段艰难时期。

pursuit.sentenceEn: So what's the appeal of a long, sweaty day in pursuit of an elusive, fast-moving wild animal?
pursuit.translationZh: 那么，花上漫长而汗流浃背的一天，去追逐一只难以捉摸、行动迅速的野生动物，究竟有什么吸引力呢？

pursuit.sentenceEn: But despite common misconceptions, a gap year does not hinder the success of academic pursuits – in fact, it probably enhances it.
pursuit.translationZh: 但尽管存在普遍误解，间隔年并不会阻碍学术追求的成功——事实上，它可能会促进学业成功。
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

pursuit.sentenceEn: According to the standard history of American philosophy, nowhere else in colonial America was "so much importance attached to intellectual pursuits ."
pursuit.translationZh: 根据美国标准哲学史记载，在殖民时期的美洲，没有任何其他地区“如此重视对知识的追求”。
pursuit.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pursuit.sentenceEn: The New England colonies were the scenes of important episodes in the pursuit of widely understood ideals of civility and virtuosity.
pursuit.translationZh: 新英格兰殖民地是追求广为认同的文明与美德理想过程中诸多重要事件的发生地。
pursuit.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

pursuit.sentenceEn: Good writing most often occurs when you are in hot pursuit of an idea rather than in a nervous search for errors.
pursuit.translationZh: 优秀的写作往往出现在你热切追寻某个想法时，而非紧张地搜寻错误之际。
pursuit.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
pursuit.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

pursuit.sentenceEn: It is in pursuit of quality service.
pursuit.translationZh: 这是为了追求优质服务。

panel.sentenceEn: One of the past winners, Professor Martin Green from the University of New South Wales, Australia, is the inventor of the Passivated Emitter and Rear Cell technology which is now found in most of the world's solar panels .
panel.translationZh: 往届获奖者之一、澳大利亚新南威尔士大学的马丁·格林教授是发射极和背面钝化电池技术的发明者，如今这项技术已应用于全球大多数太阳能电池板。
panel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

panel.sentenceEn: Solar panels had a few niche uses until they became cheap; now they are transforming the global energy system.
panel.translationZh: 太阳能电池板在价格亲民之前仅有少数特定用途；如今，它们正在改变全球能源系统。
panel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

panel.sentenceEn: Automatic doors often open to the side, with the panels sliding across one another.
panel.translationZh: 自动门通常向侧面开启，门片相互滑动。
panel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

panel.sentenceEn: The cost of solar panels has dropped by 80 percent and the cost of wind turbines by close to one-third in the past eight years.
panel.translationZh: 过去八年间，太阳能电池板的成本下降了80%，风力涡轮机的成本则降低了近三分之一。
panel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

panel.sentenceEn: The SBoRE panel will then find external statisticians to review these manuscripts.
panel.translationZh: 随后，该统计审查编辑委员会（SBoRE）将聘请外部统计学家对这些稿件进行评审。
panel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

panel.sentenceEn: The Federal Circuit issued an unusual order stating that the case would be heard by all 12 of the court's judges, rather than a typical panel of three, and that one issue it wants to evaluate is whether it should "reconsider" its State Street Bank ruling.
panel.translationZh: 联邦巡回上诉法院发布了一项不同寻常的指令，宣布该案将由全院12名法官共同审理，而非通常的3人法官小组。同时，法院表示希望评估的一个问题是，是否应当"重新考虑"其对道富银行案的裁决。
panel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

performer.sentenceEn: We are eliminating a stage, booking fewer performers and making additional cuts to reduce our costs, all while striving to keep the festival as vibrant as ever, as supportive of local artists and businesses, and as true to Wicker Park's unique spirit and reputation as festgoers have come to expect.
performer.translationZh: 我们正在通过取消一个舞台、减少表演嘉宾人数以及采取其他削减措施来降低成本。与此同时，我们仍将竭尽全力，确保音乐节一如既往地充满活力，继续支持当地艺术家和商家，并坚守参与者们所期待的柳条公园（Wicker Park）那独特的精神与名声。
performer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

performer.sentenceEn: Even if a state is considered a high performer in its science standards, "that does not mean it will be taught", he says.
performer.translationZh: 他说，即便某个州的科学教育标准被认为很出色，“也并不意味着这些标准会真正被落实到教学中”。
performer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

performer.sentenceEn: Among the 10 worst performers were some of the most populous states, including Texas, which was given the lowest grade (F) and has a disproportionate influence because its textbooks are widely sold elsewhere.
performer.translationZh: 在表现最差的10个州中，不乏一些人口最多的州，其中包括得克萨斯州——该州被评为最低等级（F级），但其影响力却不成比例地大，因为该州的教科书在其他地区也有广泛销售。
performer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

performer.sentenceEn: A toothy grin (especially when there were gaps or blackened gnashers) lacked class: drunks, tramps, and music hall performers might gurn and grin with a smile as wide as Lewis Carroll's gum-exposing Cheshire Cat, but it was not a becoming look for properly bred persons.
performer.translationZh: 露齿大笑（尤其是牙齿有缝隙或发黑时）会显得缺乏教养：醉汉、流浪汉和杂耍剧场演员或许会挤眉弄眼，咧嘴大笑，笑得像刘易斯·卡罗尔笔下咧嘴露牙龈的柴郡猫一样，但对于有良好教养的人而言，这绝非得体的表情。
performer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

performer.sentenceEn: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
performer.translationZh: 在被评估的163个国家中，英国在将经济增长转化为公民切实福祉方面表现最差之一。
performer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

performer.sentenceEn: His compositions demand the performer to show courage, for example in the use of dynamics.
performer.translationZh: 他的作品要求演奏者展现出勇气，例如在力度的运用上。
performer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

perspective.sentenceEn: Instead, listen to their concerns fully, try to understand their perspective , and include their concerns (and possible remedies) in future discussions.
perspective.translationZh: 相反，要充分倾听他们的顾虑，努力理解他们的观点，并在未来的讨论中纳入他们的担忧（以及可能的解决办法）。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第4句

perspective.sentenceEn: Branch points out that, even if a growing number of official guidelines and textbooks reflect scientific consensus on climate change, unofficial educational materials that convey more slanted perspectives are being distributed to teachers.
perspective.translationZh: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指南和教科书反映了气候变化方面的科学共识，但一些传达更具倾向性观点的非官方教育材料仍在向教师们传播。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

perspective.sentenceEn: Things changed, however, when an innovative project-marketing manager came aboard, created a growth team and sparked the kind of fresh perspective they needed.
perspective.translationZh: 然而，当一位富有创新精神的项目营销经理加入公司，组建了增长团队，并带来了他们所需的全新视角后，情况发生了改变。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

perspective.sentenceEn: This perspective makes sense if you simplify the workings of a complex brain, reducing it to an array of electrical pulses; cells in plants also communicate through electrical signals.
perspective.translationZh: 如果你将复杂大脑的运作机制简化为一系列电脉冲，那么这种观点确实有一定道理；植物细胞也通过电信号进行交流。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

perspective.sentenceEn: Indeed, in "An International Perspective on New Zealand's Productivity Paradox" (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country's poor productivity growth record.
perspective.translationZh: 事实上，在《新西兰生产力悖论的国际视角》（2014年）报告中，生产力委员会明确指出，管理能力低下是该国生产力增长记录不佳的一个原因。
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

perspective.sentenceEn: It's just about putting things into perspective .
perspective.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

poetry.sentenceEn: No one knows for sure when poetry began but it has been around for thousands of years, even before people could write.
poetry.translationZh: 没人确切知道诗歌起源于何时，但它已经存在了数千年，甚至在人类掌握书写能力之前就已出现。
poetry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

poetry.sentenceEn: By the time that Shakespeare was twenty-five, Lyly, Peele, and Greene had made comedies that were at once popular and literary; Kyd had written a tragedy that crowded the pit; and Marlowe had brought poetry and genius to triumph on the common stage – where they had played no part since the death of Euripides.
poetry.translationZh: 到莎士比亚二十五岁时，利里、皮尔和格林已创作出既通俗又具文学性的喜剧；基德写出了一部让剧场正厅座无虚席的悲剧；而马洛则将诗歌与天才带上了大众舞台并大获成功——自欧里庇得斯去世后，诗歌与天才在这个舞台上便已销声匿迹。
poetry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

poetry.sentenceEn: So poor in one sense was it that he never could remember for more than a few days a single date or a line of poetry .
poetry.translationZh: 从某种意义上说，他的记忆力如此糟糕，以至于连一个日期或一行诗句都记不住几天以上。
poetry.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
poetry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

poetry.sentenceEn: Up to the age of thirty or beyond it poetry of many kinds gave him great pleasure.
poetry.translationZh: 直到三十岁或三十多岁，各类诗歌都曾带给他极大的乐趣。
poetry.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
poetry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

poetry.sentenceEn: In 1881, however, he said: "Now for many years I cannot endure to read a line of poetry . I have also almost lost my taste for pictures or music."
poetry.translationZh: 然而，他在1881年写道：“多年来，我已无法忍受阅读哪怕一行诗歌。我对绘画和音乐的鉴赏力也几乎丧失殆尽。”
poetry.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
poetry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

poetry.sentenceEn: But the cult of the authentic and the personal, "doing our own thing", has spelt the death of formal speech, writing, poetry and music.
poetry.translationZh: 但是，这种对真实性和个性的狂热追求——即“做自己的事”——已经导致了正式演讲、写作、诗歌和音乐的消亡。
poetry.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
poetry.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

personality.sentenceEn: The clothes we choose can reflect our personality , mood, and identity.
personality.translationZh: 我们选择的着装可以反映我们的个性、心情和身份。
personality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

personality.sentenceEn: In people who score high in a test of neuroticism, a personality dimension associated with self-consciousness and anxiety, eye contact triggered more activity associated with avoidance, according to the Finnish researcher Jari Hietanen and colleagues.
personality.translationZh: 芬兰研究人员亚里·希塔宁及其同事发现，在神经质测试中得分较高的人群中——神经质是一种与自我意识和焦虑相关的人格维度——眼神接触会引发更多与回避相关的活动。
personality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

personality.sentenceEn: However, during that course I realized I was not good enough in this area to compete with other creative personalities in the future, so I decided that it was not the right path for me.
personality.translationZh: 然而，在那门课程学习期间，我意识到自己在这个领域的才华不足以在未来与其他富有创造力的人才竞争，因此我断定这并非我的正确道路。
personality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

personality.sentenceEn: It takes a while to judge complex aspects of personality , like neuroticism or open-mindedness.
personality.translationZh: 要判断性格的复杂方面，如神经质倾向或开放心态，需要一段时间。
personality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

personality.sentenceEn: He appears as a character, or a collection of American personalities , in the 1945 movie The Story of G.I. Joe, based on the last days of war correspondent Ernie Pyle.
personality.translationZh: 他作为一个角色，或者说是一众美国士兵形象的集合，出现在1945年的电影《美国大兵乔的故事》中，这部电影基于战地记者厄尼·派尔生命最后几天的经历改编而成。
personality.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

personality.sentenceEn: Personality can affect how a person reacts to eye contact
personality.translationZh: 性格会影响人对眼神接触的反应方式

pose.sentenceEn: Avoiding dangers posed by all those human drivers would require too many algorithms, she said.
pose.translationZh: 她说，要想规避所有这些人类驾驶员带来的危险，需要编写太多的算法。
pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

pose.sentenceEn: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.
pose.translationZh: 当然，我必须承认，我收集的这些'微笑的维多利亚人'照片，只占1840至1900年间浩如烟海的人像摄影作品中的极小一部分。绝大多数照片中的人物都在彩绘背景前摆着痛苦而僵硬的姿势，或是茫然地凝视着远方。
pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pose.sentenceEn: The coming use of autonomous vehicles, for example, poses thorny ethical questions.
pose.translationZh: 例如，自动驾驶汽车的即将投入使用就带来了棘手的伦理问题。
pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

pose.sentenceEn: Noting the "medical/psychological" nature of problem gambling behavior, the letter said that before being readmitted to the casino he would have to present medical/psychological information demonstrating that patronizing the casino would pose no threat to his safety or well-being.
pose.translationZh: 该信件指出问题赌博行为具有'医疗/心理'性质，并说明在他重新进入赌场之前，必须提供医疗/心理方面的信息，以证明光顾赌场不会对其安全或健康构成威胁。
pose.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

pose.sentenceEn: So short-sighted Zysman junior gets stuck in the back row, and is rarely asked the improving questions posed by those insensitive teachers.
pose.translationZh: 因此，眼睛近视的小齐斯曼（Zysman）就被安排在后排，那些不体谅人的老师很少向他提出有助于提升的问题。
pose.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
pose.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

pose.sentenceEn: remarks that significant moves may pose challenges to children.
pose.translationZh: 称重大搬家可能给孩子带来困难

practical.sentenceEn: In a very practical way, the Internet is becoming an external hard drive for our memories, a process known as "cognitive offloading."
practical.translationZh: 从非常实际的角度来看，互联网正成为我们记忆的外部硬盘，这一过程被称为'认知卸载'。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

practical.sentenceEn: A more practical goal is to try, to the best of your ability, to be as tolerant and composed as you can when faced with trying situations involving your children.
practical.translationZh: 一个更实际的目标是，在面对与孩子相关的棘手情况时，尽你所能地保持宽容和冷静。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

practical.sentenceEn: If "entitled" is the most common adjective, fairly or not, applied to millennials (those born between 1981 and 1995), the catchwords for Generation Z are practical and cautious.
practical.translationZh: 如果说“有 entitlement 心态”是人们用来形容千禧一代（1981年至1995年出生的人）最常见的形容词——无论这种说法是否公平——那么Z世代的关键词则是务实和谨慎。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

practical.sentenceEn: He is a teacher at a New Hampshire high school where learning is not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical .
practical.translationZh: 他是新罕布什尔州一所高中的教师，在这所学校里，学习并非书本、考试和机械记忆的代名词，而是注重实践。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

practical.sentenceEn: That is a necessary and practical approach.
practical.translationZh: 这是一种必要且切实可行的方法。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

practical.sentenceEn: Their thesis – that a relatively modest intervention could have a big impact – was based on the view that first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students.
practical.translationZh: 他们的论点——一项相对简单的干预措施可能会产生重大影响——基于这样一种观点：第一代大学生最缺乏的可能不是潜力，而是如何应对大多数大学生所面临问题的实用知识。
practical.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: The influence of wearables on psychology refers to how the clothes we wear affect our thoughts, feelings, and behaviors.
psychology.translationZh: 穿戴物对心理的影响，是指我们所穿的衣服如何影响我们的思维、情感和行为。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: In a paper published in the Journal of Child Psychology and Psychiatry, researchers said that the western nuclear family was a recent invention which broke with evolutionary history.
psychology.translationZh: 在《儿童心理学与精神病学杂志》发表的一篇论文中，研究人员指出，西方核心家庭是近代的产物，它打破了人类的进化史。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: "There may be costs associated with our increased reliance on the Internet, but I'd have to imagine that overall the benefits are going to outweigh those costs," observes psychology professor Benjamin Storm.
psychology.translationZh: 心理学教授本杰明·斯托姆指出：“我们对互联网的依赖加深可能会带来一些代价，但我认为总体而言，其益处将超过这些代价。”
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: The Internet may be changing merely what we remember, not our capacity to do so, suggests Columbia University psychology professor Betsy Sparrow.
psychology.translationZh: 哥伦比亚大学心理学教授贝齐·斯派洛指出，互联网可能仅仅改变了我们记忆的内容，而非我们的记忆能力。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

psychology.sentenceEn: Work by Tina Malti, a psychology professor at the University of Toronto, suggests that guilt may compensate for an emotional deficiency.
psychology.translationZh: 多伦多大学心理学教授蒂娜·马尔蒂的研究表明，内疚感可能会弥补某种情感缺陷。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

psychology.sentenceEn: "There has been a kind of revival or a rethinking about what guilt is and what role guilt can serve," says Amrisha Vaish, a psychology researcher at the University of Virginia, adding that this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another.
psychology.translationZh: 弗吉尼亚大学的心理学研究员阿姆里莎·瓦伊什表示：“学术界正在重新兴起对愧疚感的研究，或者说重新思考愧疚感是什么以及它能起到什么作用。”她补充道，这种重新审视是人们更广泛认识的一部分——即情绪并非二元对立的，在一种情境中有利的情绪在另一种情境中可能有害。
psychology.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

pursue.sentenceEn: If that sounds melodramatic, consider this: The Art Directors Guild, a labor union representing about 3,000 film workers, has suspended a training program and issued a statement explaining that "we cannot in good conscience encourage you to pursue our profession."
pursue.translationZh: 如果这听起来有些夸大其词，请考虑这样一个事实：代表约 3000 名电影从业者的工会——美国艺术指导工会，已经暂停了一项培训计划，并发布声明称：“凭良心讲，我们无法鼓励你们从事这一职业。”
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

pursue.sentenceEn: As adults, it seems that we are constantly pursuing happiness, often with mixed results.
pursue.translationZh: 作为成年人，我们似乎一直在追求幸福，但其结果往往喜忧参半。
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

pursue.sentenceEn: Rather than cloaking his exit in the usual vague excuses, he came right out and said he was leaving "to pursue my goal of running a company."
pursue.translationZh: 他没有用通常那种模糊的借口来掩饰自己的离职，而是直截了当地表示，他离开是为了“追求自己经营一家公司的目标”。
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

pursue.sentenceEn: At the same time, listening through earphones to the same monotonous beats for long stretches encourages kids to stay inside their bubble instead of pursuing other endeavors.
pursue.translationZh: 与此同时，长时间戴着耳机听单调重复的音乐节拍，会让孩子沉浸在自己的小世界里，不愿去尝试其他活动。
pursue.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第3句

pursue.sentenceEn: Even our schools are where we send our children to get a practical education—not to pursue knowledge for the sake of knowledge.
pursue.translationZh: 就连学校，我们送孩子去也是为了接受实用教育——而非为了知识本身而去追求知识。
pursue.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
pursue.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

pursue.sentenceEn: Give priority to pursuing its net-zero strategy.

partly.sentenceEn: The huge improvements in Italy's obsolete infrastructure partly explained the disruption, said Ferrovie.
partly.translationZh: 意大利国家铁路公司表示，该国陈旧基础设施的大规模改造工程是造成交通中断的部分原因。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

partly.sentenceEn: According to Sichel, although the falling price of nails was driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy, most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways to turn steel into nails.
partly.translationZh: 西谢尔指出，尽管钉子价格下降部分源于铁价和能源成本的降低，但大部分功劳应归于钉子制造商——他们找到了将钢材转化为钉子的更高效方法。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

partly.sentenceEn: For public institutions, state funds are sometimes tied partly to their success on metrics such as graduation rates and student retention – so better grades can, by boosting figures like those, mean more money.
partly.translationZh: 对于公立院校而言，州政府拨款有时部分取决于其在毕业率和学生保留率等指标上的表现——因此，通过提高这些数据，更好的成绩可能意味着更多的资金。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

partly.sentenceEn: This is partly because universities continue to produce ever more PhDs.
partly.translationZh: 部分原因是大学一直在培养越来越多的博士。

partly.sentenceEn: And dead markets partly reflect the paralysis of banks which will not sell assets for fear of booking losses, yet are reluctant to buy all those supposed bargains.
partly.translationZh: 而死气沉沉的市场在一定程度上反映了银行的瘫痪状态：它们因担心记录损失而不愿出售资产，同时又不愿购买那些所谓的便宜货。
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

partly.sentenceEn: The behavioral sciences have been slow to change partly because the explanatory items often seem to be directly observed and partly because other kinds of explanations have been hard to find.
partly.translationZh: 行为科学的变革之所以缓慢，部分原因在于这些解释性概念往往看似可以直接观察到，另一部分原因则是其他类型的解释一直难以找到。
partly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
partly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第5句

precisely.sentenceEn: In return for all of this, you'll be asked for precisely nothing.
precisely.translationZh: 作为这一切的回报，你不需要付出任何代价。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

precisely.sentenceEn: The researchers are convinced that the elephants always know precisely where they are in relation to all the resources they need, and can therefore take shortcuts, as well as following familiar routes.
precisely.translationZh: 研究人员确信，大象总能精确地知道自己相对于所需资源的位置，因此它们既能走熟悉的路线，也能抄近路。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第7句

precisely.sentenceEn: Precisely because readers from different historical periods, places and social experiences produce different but overlapping readings of the same words on the page–including for texts that engage with fundamental human concerns – debates about texts can play an important role in social discussion of beliefs and values.
precisely.translationZh: 正是因为来自不同历史时期、不同地域和不同社会经历的读者会对书页上相同的文字产生既有所不同又相互重叠的解读——包括那些探讨人类基本关切的文本——关于文本的讨论才能在社会对信仰和价值观的探讨中发挥重要作用。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

precisely.sentenceEn: I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music.
precisely.translationZh: 我认为，正是这种通过物质手段传递形而上学信息的永恒共存，构成了音乐的力量。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

precisely.sentenceEn: In the last decade or so, advances in technology have allowed mass-market labels such as Zara, H&M, and Uniqlo to react to trends more quickly and anticipate demand more precisely .
precisely.translationZh: 在过去十年左右的时间里，技术进步使Zara、H&M和优衣库等大众市场品牌能够更迅速地响应潮流，并更精准地预测需求。
precisely.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

precisely.sentenceEn: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human. Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
precisely.translationZh: 当然，正是这些看似多余的事物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何为人类。下载和消费文化需要高超的技能，但如果无法超越下载的阶段，我们就剥夺了自己身为人类的一个关键特质。

preference.sentenceEn: This customized approach aims to cater to individual preferences and enhance the concept of beauty tailored to each person's unique characteristics.
preference.translationZh: 这种定制化方法旨在迎合个人喜好，并根据每个人的独特特质提升个性化的美学理念。
preference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

preference.sentenceEn: Individuals can now experiment with different looks and explore their preferences , potentially expanding the range of beauty ideals.
preference.translationZh: 现在，人们可以尝试不同的形象并探索个人偏好，这有可能进一步拓宽审美标准的范围。
preference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

preference.sentenceEn: Navigating beyond the organised pavements and parks of our urban spaces, desire paths are the unofficial footprints of a community, revealing the unspoken preferences , shared shortcuts and collective choices of humans.
preference.translationZh: 在城市中规划整齐的人行道和公园之外，那些被称为'欲望小径'的非官方路径如同社区留下的隐形足迹，它们揭示了人们未曾言说的偏好、共同使用的捷径以及群体的集体选择。
preference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

preference.sentenceEn: For example, AI can be used to analyse what type of advertising content or copy would be appropriate to "speak" to a specific target customer group by revealing information about trends and preferences through the analysis of big data.
preference.translationZh: 例如，人工智能可以通过大数据分析揭示有关趋势和偏好的信息，从而分析出何种类型的广告内容或文案适合与特定目标客户群体进行“沟通”。
preference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

preference.sentenceEn: Thinking too much can also harm our ability to form preferences .
preference.translationZh: 思虑过多还会损害我们形成偏好的能力。
preference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

preference.sentenceEn: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
preference.translationZh: 从职业发展到社区生活再到家庭观念，这些差异表明，在灼痛人心的"大衰退"之后，那些刚刚踏入社会的年轻人正在确立自己的优先事项和期望，而这些观念将逐渐渗透到美国生活的方方面面，从消费偏好到住房模式，再到政治取向。
preference.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

prompt.sentenceEn: These systems often prompted customers to tip for services that were not previously tipped.
prompt.translationZh: 这些系统常常会提示顾客为以前不需要给小费的服务支付小费。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

prompt.sentenceEn: The tool, along with other popular image-generation AI models, allows anyone to create impressive images based on text prompts .
prompt.translationZh: 这款工具与其他流行的图像生成AI模型一样，任何人都能通过文字提示创建出令人印象深刻的图像。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

prompt.sentenceEn: His distinctive style is now one of the most commonly used prompts in the new open-source AI art generator Stable Diffusion.
prompt.translationZh: 他独特的风格如今已成为新开源AI艺术生成器Stable Diffusion中最常用的提示词之一。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

prompt.sentenceEn: According to the website Lexica, which tracks over 10 million Stable Diffusion images and prompts , Rutkowski's name has been used as a prompt around 93,000 times.
prompt.translationZh: 据追踪超过1000万张Stable Diffusion图像和提示词的网站Lexica统计，鲁特科夫斯基的名字已被用作提示词约93,000次。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

prompt.sentenceEn: Such an approach can both prompt new research as well as result in powerful art.
prompt.translationZh: 这种合作方式既能催生新的研究，也能孕育出富有感染力的艺术作品。
prompt.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

prompt.sentenceEn: What prompted the chancellor to develop his scheme?
prompt.translationZh: 是什么促使财政大臣制定了他的计划？

psychological.sentenceEn: This step may sound overly deferential, but it's a smart way to give the powerful person psychological safety and control.
psychological.translationZh: 这一步骤听起来可能过于恭顺，但却是给予权势者心理安全感和掌控感的明智之举。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

psychological.sentenceEn: This has created "a paradox" in that recruiting first-generation students, but then watching many of them fail, means that higher education has "continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close" an achievement gap based on social class, according to the depressing beginning of a paper forthcoming in the journal Psychological Science.
psychological.translationZh: 《心理科学》期刊即将发表的一篇论文在开头便揭示了这一令人沮丧的现象：这种做法形成了一个"悖论"——招收第一代大学生，却眼睁睁看着他们中的许多人学业失败，这意味着高等教育"非但没有缩小基于社会阶层的成就差距，反而在持续复制并扩大它"。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

psychological.sentenceEn: Visual recognition, reads the study, is "an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation".
psychological.translationZh: 该研究指出，视觉识别是“一种自动的心理过程，它快速且直观地发生，几乎或完全没有明显的有意识思考”。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

psychological.sentenceEn: When we are deprived of green, of plants, of trees, most of us give in to a demoralization of spirit which we usually blame on some psychological conditions, until one day we find ourselves in a garden and feel the oppression vanish as if by magic.
psychological.translationZh: 当我们被剥夺了绿色、植物和树木的环绕时，大多数人会陷入精神萎靡的状态，而我们通常将这种状态归咎于某些心理问题，直到有一天我们置身于某个花园中，才会感到那种压抑感奇迹般地消失了。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

psychological.sentenceEn: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
psychological.translationZh: 我之前从未意识到，营销趋势对我们关于儿童天性的认知——包括我们对他们心理发展的核心信念——产生了多么深远的影响。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

psychological.sentenceEn: Such bodily reaction might conceivably help moderate the effects of psychological stress.
psychological.translationZh: 这种身体反应或许有助于缓解心理压力带来的影响。
psychological.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

partner.sentenceEn: During conversations with short gaps, people feel more connected to their conversation partners .
partner.translationZh: 在对话中有短暂间隔时，人们会感觉与交谈对象的联系更紧密。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

partner.sentenceEn: She found similar interference when participants watched 15-second clips of pairs of people and judged whether they were strangers, friends, or dating partners .
partner.translationZh: 当参与者观看15秒的双人片段并判断他们是陌生人、朋友还是约会对象时，她发现了类似的干扰现象。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

partner.sentenceEn: "They bought the seedlings and closed them down," complained Paul Arnold, a partner at San Francisco-based Switch Ventures, putting an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors.
partner.translationZh: 总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道：“他们买下这些幼苗企业，然后就把它们扼杀了”，终止了那些有朝一日可能成为竞争对手的企业。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

partner.sentenceEn: Says Korn/Ferry senior partner Dennis Carey: "I can't think of a single search I've done where a board has not instructed me to look at sitting CEOs first."
partner.translationZh: 光辉国际(Korn/Ferry)高级合伙人丹尼斯·凯里表示：“在我所做的每一次招聘中，董事会都明确指示我首先考虑在任首席执行官。”
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

partner.sentenceEn: I found, as Hacker observed years before, that most wives want their husbands to be, first and foremost, conversational partners , but few husbands share this expectation of their wives.
partner.translationZh: 正如哈克多年前所观察到的那样，我发现大多数妻子首先希望丈夫成为能与之交谈的伴侣，但很少有丈夫对妻子抱有同样的期望。
partner.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

partner.sentenceEn: "This breaks the major rule in the American belief system – that anyone can do anything," explains M. J. Ryan, author of the 2006 book This Year I Will… and Ms. Markova's business partner .
partner.translationZh: M·J·瑞安是2006年出版的《今年我将……》一书的作者，同时也是马尔科娃女士的商业伙伴，她解释道：“这打破了美国信仰体系中的一条重要准则——即任何人都可以成就任何事。”
partner.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
