peak.sentenceEn: But 2022 was the peak of peak TV.
peak.translationZh: 但 2022 年是‘剧集大爆发’的巅峰之年。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

peak.sentenceEn: We were kept afloat by " peak TV", the glut of content that was required by the explosion of streaming services.
peak.translationZh: 过去，我们依靠“电视巅峰时代”得以维持，那是流媒体服务爆炸式增长所催生出的内容过剩时期。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

peak.sentenceEn: It peaks in young adulthood, levels out for a period of time, and then generally starts to slowly decline as we age.
peak.translationZh: 它在青年时期达到顶峰，保持一段时间稳定水平，然后通常会随着年龄增长开始缓慢下降。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

peak.sentenceEn: Resting in the Pacific Ocean, Mauna Kea's peak rises above the bulk of our planet's dense atmosphere, where conditions allow telescopes to obtain images of unsurpassed clarity.
peak.translationZh: 莫纳克亚山矗立在太平洋中，其峰顶高耸于地球大部分浓密大气层之上，那里的条件使望远镜能够获得清晰度无与伦比的图像。
peak.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

peak.sentenceEn: At its peak around AD 600, this city was one of the largest human settlements in the world.
peak.translationZh: 在公元600年左右的鼎盛时期，这座城市是世界上最大的人类聚居地之一。

peak.sentenceEn: It tends to peak in adolescence.
peak.translationZh: 它往往在青春期达到顶峰。

percentage.sentenceEn: Today, 28 per cent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles, a percentage which is double the average among the OECD countries.
percentage.translationZh: 如今，英国28%的大学毕业生从事着无需学位的工作，这一比例是经济合作与发展组织（OECD）国家平均水平的两倍。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

percentage.sentenceEn: The percentage of retirement-age people in the labor force has doubled over the past three decades.
percentage.translationZh: 过去三十年来，处于退休年龄却仍在劳动力市场的人口比例翻了一番。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

percentage.sentenceEn: Of course, I need to concede that my collection of 'Smiling Victorians' makes up only a tiny percentage of the vast catalogue of photographic portraiture created between 1840 and 1900, the majority of which show sitters posing miserably and stiffly in front of painted backdrops, or staring absently into the middle distance.
percentage.translationZh: 当然，我必须承认，我收集的这些'微笑的维多利亚人'照片，只占1840至1900年间浩如烟海的人像摄影作品中的极小一部分。绝大多数照片中的人物都在彩绘背景前摆着痛苦而僵硬的姿势，或是茫然地凝视着远方。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

percentage.sentenceEn: In 2015, the US Forest Service for the first time spent more than half of its $5.5 billion annual budget fighting fires – nearly double the percentage it spent on such efforts 20 years ago.
percentage.translationZh: 2015年，美国林务局首次将其55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于火灾扑救——这一比例几乎是20年前的两倍。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

percentage.sentenceEn: For example, many collegiate and professional football players qualify as obese, though their percentage body fat is low.
percentage.translationZh: 例如，许多大学生和职业橄榄球运动员的BMI达到肥胖标准，尽管他们的体脂率很低。
percentage.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

percentage.sentenceEn: During the late 1990s, national spending on social sciences and the humanities as a percentage of all research and development funds – including government, higher education, non-profit and corporate – varied from around 4% to 25%; in most European nations, it is about 15%.
percentage.translationZh: 20世纪90年代末，各国在社会科学和人文科学上的支出占所有研发基金（包括政府、高等教育机构、非营利组织和企业的研发基金）的比例从4%到25%不等；在大多数欧洲国家，这一比例约为15%。

permission.sentenceEn: But these open-source programs are built by scraping images from the Internet, often without permission and proper attribution to artists.
permission.translationZh: 但这些开源程序是通过从互联网上抓取图片构建而成的，而且往往未获得艺术家的许可，也未给予他们应有的署名。
permission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

permission.sentenceEn: Further arrangements – and there may be many – between the NHS and DeepMind will be carefully scrutinised to ensure that all necessary permissions have been asked of patients and all unnecessary data has been cleaned.
permission.translationZh: 英国国民医疗服务体系(NHS)与深度思维公司(DeepMind)之间可能还会有更多后续合作安排，这些安排都将受到严格审查，以确保已获得患者的所有必要许可，并且所有无关数据都已被清除。
permission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

permission.sentenceEn: When he feels down – say, after giving a bad lecture – he grants himself permission to be human.
permission.translationZh: 当他感到沮丧时——比如说，在讲了一堂糟糕的课后——他会允许自己展现人性的弱点。
permission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

permission.sentenceEn: Or should they have explicit permission ?
permission.translationZh: 还是说他们应当获得用户的明确许可？
permission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

permission.sentenceEn: With or without permission , they straddle laws, jurisdictions and identities with ease.
permission.translationZh: 无论是否获得许可，他们都能轻松跨越法律、司法管辖区域和身份的界限。
permission.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

permission.translationZh: 请求允许表达不同意见

planning.sentenceEn: Urban planners interpret desire paths as more than just convenient shortcuts; they offer valuable insights into the dynamics between planning and behaviour.
planning.translationZh: 城市规划师认为， desire paths 不仅仅是便捷的捷径；它们还为理解规划与行为之间的动态关系提供了宝贵见解。
planning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

planning.sentenceEn: The need for such planning is increasingly urgent.
planning.translationZh: 此类规划的必要性日益迫切。
planning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

planning.sentenceEn: The anticipation of possible shifts in demand provided by this study is significant: It gives a basis to all organisations which seek to promote the learning and use of English, a basis for planning to meet the possibilities of what could be a very different operating environment.
planning.translationZh: 这项研究对需求可能发生的变化所做的预测具有重要意义：它为所有致力于推广英语学习和使用的机构提供了一个基础，一个为应对可能截然不同的运营环境而制定规划的基础。
planning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

planning.sentenceEn: Indeed, there is something a little absurd in the state getting involved in the planning of such a fundamentally "grassroots" concept as community sports associations.
planning.translationZh: 的确，政府介入社区体育协会这类本质上属于"草根"概念的规划，多少有些荒唐。
planning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

planning.sentenceEn: Half a century of town and country planning has enabled it to retain an enviable rural coherence, while still permitting low-density urban living.
planning.translationZh: 半个世纪的城乡规划使英国得以保持令人羡慕的乡村协调性，同时又能维持低密度的城市生活。
planning.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

planning.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

platform.sentenceEn: Back then platforms such as Netflix, Amazon and Apple TV hemorrhaged billions of dollars to generate content to attract new subscribers, resulting in 633 scripted series being released that year.
platform.translationZh: 当时，Netflix、亚马逊和 Apple TV 等平台投入了数十亿美元来制作内容以吸引新订阅者，导致当年发布的剧本剧集达到了 633 部。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

platform.sentenceEn: But, with this newfound connection, many of us share sensitive, sometimes highly confidential information, even though over a third of people don't realise that AI platforms may not be very good at keeping our secrets…secret.
platform.translationZh: 但是，随着这种连接的日益紧密，我们中的许多人开始分享敏感甚至高度机密的信息，尽管超过三分之一的人并未意识到，AI 平台在保护个人秘密方面可能并不可靠。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

platform.sentenceEn: But the age of streaming has been a boon for some unintended winners: pirates that use software to rip a film or television show in seconds from legitimate online video platforms and host the titles on their own, illegitimate services, which rake in about $2 billion annually from ads and subscriptions.
platform.translationZh: 但流媒体时代却意外地成就了一批赢家：盗版者利用软件在几秒钟内从合法在线视频平台上窃取电影或电视节目，然后将这些内容放在自己的非法网站上。这些盗版网站每年通过广告和订阅能赚取约20亿美元。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

platform.sentenceEn: With no video production costs, illegal streaming sites have achieved profit margins approaching 90%, according to the Motion Picture Association (MPA), a trade group representing Hollywood studios that's working to crack down on the thousands of illegal platforms that have cropped up in recent years.
platform.translationZh: 据代表好莱坞各大制片厂的行业组织——美国电影协会（MPA）称，由于没有视频制作成本，非法流媒体网站的利润率已接近90%。该协会正致力于打击近年来涌现的数千个非法平台。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

platform.sentenceEn: Digital services include everything from providing a platform for selling goods and services online to targeting advertising based on user data, and the tax applies to gross revenue from such services.
platform.translationZh: 数字服务涵盖各种业务，从提供在线商品和服务销售平台，到基于用户数据的定向广告，而这项税收将适用于此类服务的总收入。
platform.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

platform.sentenceEn: subscribers grew wary of large platforms .
platform.translationZh: 订阅者对大型平台开始产生警惕心理。

politician.sentenceEn: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
politician.translationZh: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将其称为"GAFA税"，这意味着该税主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司——换句话说，就是总部设在美国的跨国科技企业。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

politician.sentenceEn: "Whether you're a politician or a parent, it might be helpful to keep in mind that trying to maintain eye contact may backfire if you're trying to convince someone who has a different set of beliefs than you," said Minson.
politician.translationZh: 明森指出：“无论你是政治家还是为人父母，都应该记住，当你试图说服与你持有不同信念的人时，刻意保持眼神接触可能会适得其反。”
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第3句

politician.sentenceEn: The building has housed some of the nation's most significant diplomats and politicians and has been the scene of many historic events.
politician.translationZh: 这座建筑曾容纳过美国一些最重要的外交官和政治家，也见证了诸多历史性事件。

politician.sentenceEn: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
politician.translationZh: 政客们一再采用"后加载"的方式处理公共部门的薪酬协议，保持适度的薪资增长，却增加了假期，尤其是本已丰厚的养老金。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

politician.sentenceEn: As the cost to everyone else has become clearer, politicians have begun to clamp down.
politician.translationZh: 随着这种体制对其他所有人造成的代价日益明显，政治家们已开始采取强硬措施。
politician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

politician.sentenceEn: They are deemed too mild for politicians .
politician.translationZh: 这些措施在政客看来过于温和。

possibly.sentenceEn: How can the train operators possibly justify yet another increase to rail passenger fares?
possibly.translationZh: 铁路运营商又一次提高客运票价，这究竟如何说得过去？
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

possibly.sentenceEn: One study found that people responded best to comments that shifted from negative to positive, possibly because it suggested they had won somebody over.
possibly.translationZh: 一项研究发现，人们对那些从负面转向正面的评价反应最佳，这可能是因为这暗示着他们已经赢得了对方的认可。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第9段，第5句

possibly.sentenceEn: Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology.
possibly.translationZh: 在科学界复杂的社会结构中，研究者做出发现；编辑和评审人员通过控制发表流程扮演着守门人的角色；其他科学家则利用这一新发现来满足自身需求；最终，公众（包括其他科学家）接收这一新发现及其可能随之而来的技术。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

possibly.sentenceEn: But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.
possibly.translationZh: 但在蒂娜·罗森伯格的新书《加入俱乐部》中，她提出同侪压力也可以成为一种积极力量，这要通过她所说的“社会治疗”来实现——即组织机构和官员利用群体动态的力量来帮助个人改善生活，甚至可能改善整个世界。
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

possibly.sentenceEn: Darwin was convinced that the loss of these tastes was not only a loss of happiness, but might possibly be injurious to the intellect, and more probably to the moral character.
possibly.translationZh: 达尔文深信，失去这些爱好不仅意味着失去快乐，还可能对智力造成损害，更有可能伤及道德品格。
possibly.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
possibly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

possibly.sentenceEn: Builders possibly need to submit new estimates of their projects.
possibly.translationZh: 建筑商可能需要重新提交项目预算。

painful.sentenceEn: Why do people read negative Internet comments and do other things that will obviously be painful ?
painful.translationZh: 为什么人们会阅读负面的网络评论，以及做其他明显会带来痛苦的事情呢？
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

painful.sentenceEn: A small but vocal group of Hawaiians and environmentalists have long viewed their presence as disrespect for sacred land and a painful reminder of the occupation of what was once a sovereign nation.
painful.translationZh: 长期以来，一小群直言不讳的夏威夷人和环保人士将这些望远镜的存在视为对圣地的亵渎，也是对这片曾经主权国家被占领历史的痛苦 reminder。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

painful.sentenceEn: And yet, it would be a mistake to think we are right now simply experiencing the painful side of a boom and bust cycle.
painful.translationZh: 然而，如果认为我们当前只是在经历经济繁荣与萧条周期中的阵痛，那就错了。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

painful.sentenceEn: Many said that unemployment, while extremely painful , had improved them in some ways: they had become less materialistic and more financially prudent; they were more aware of the struggles of others.
painful.translationZh: 许多人表示，尽管失业的滋味极其痛苦，但也在某些方面让他们有所成长：他们变得不那么物质至上，在财务上更加谨慎；也更能体谅他人的艰辛。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

painful.sentenceEn: It is painful to read these roundabout accounts today.
painful.translationZh: 如今读到这些拐弯抹角的说法，实在令人不快。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

painful.sentenceEn: Having endured a painful period of unsustainability in his own life made it clear to him that sustainability-oriented values must be expressed through everyday action and choice.
painful.translationZh: 经历了自己生活中一段痛苦的不可持续时期后，他清楚地认识到，以可持续发展为导向的价值观必须通过日常行动和选择来体现。
painful.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

player.sentenceEn: For example, many collegiate and professional football players qualify as obese, though their percentage body fat is low.
player.translationZh: 例如，许多大学生和职业橄榄球运动员的BMI达到肥胖标准，尽管他们的体脂率很低。

player.sentenceEn: In the case of NBA players , their increase in height appears to result from the increasingly common practice of recruiting players from all over the world.

player.sentenceEn: If you were to examine the birth certificates of every soccer player in 2006's World Cup tournament, you would most likely find a noteworthy quirk: elite soccer players are more likely to have been born in the earlier months of the year than in the later months.
player.translationZh: 如果你去查看2006年世界杯足球赛每位参赛球员的出生证明，很可能会发现一个值得注意的奇特现象：优秀足球运动员的出生月份更可能集中在年初几个月而非年末。

previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

previously.sentenceEn: Though plants lack brains, the firing of electrical signals in their stems and leaves nonetheless triggered responses that hinted at consciousness, researchers previously reported.
previously.translationZh: 研究人员此前曾报告称，尽管植物没有大脑，但其茎和叶中电信号的传递仍会引发暗示意识存在的反应。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

previously.sentenceEn: Schwitzgebel predicted the intervention would have no effect; he had previously found that ethics professors do not differ from other professors on a range of behaviors, including voting rates, blood donation and returning library books.
previously.translationZh: 施维茨格贝尔曾预测这种干预不会产生任何效果；他此前发现，伦理学教授在一系列行为上与其他教授并无不同，包括投票率、献血行为和归还图书馆书籍的情况。
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

previously.sentenceEn: "Rats have been shown to engage in multiple forms of reciprocal help and cooperation, including what is referred to as direct reciprocity where a rat will help another rat that has previously helped them," says Quinn.
previously.translationZh: 奎因指出：“研究表明，大鼠会进行多种形式的互助与合作，其中包括所谓的直接互惠——即一只大鼠会帮助另一只曾帮助过它的大鼠。”
previously.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

primarily.sentenceEn: Educators advanced the idea of having students complete detailed laboratory exercises in high schools in the belief that such work was beneficial primarily as a way to enhance logical reasoning and observational skills.
primarily.translationZh: 教育工作者提倡让高中生完成详尽的实验练习，他们认为此类活动的主要益处在于能够增强学生的逻辑推理和观察能力。
primarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

primarily.sentenceEn: Yet, reluctance persists among other planners to integrate desire paths into formal plans, citing concerns about safety, environmental impact, or primarily , aesthetics.
primarily.translationZh: 然而，其他规划者仍然不愿意将这些"欲望路径"纳入正式规划中，他们提出的理由包括安全隐患、环境影响，或者最主要的是美观问题。
primarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

primarily.sentenceEn: Notably, tipping primarily benefits some of these workers, such as waiters, but not others, such as cooks and dishwashers.
primarily.translationZh: 值得注意的是，小费主要让部分服务人员受益，例如服务员，而另一些人员如厨师和洗碗工则无法享受到这种好处。
primarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

primarily.sentenceEn: Existing health privacy law, such as the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act, is primarily focused on the way hospitals, doctors' offices, clinics and insurance companies store health records online.
primarily.translationZh: 现有的健康隐私法，如《健康保险流通与责任法案》，主要关注医院、医生办公室、诊所和保险公司在线存储健康记录的方式。
primarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

primarily.sentenceEn: Many French politicians and media outlets have referred to this as a "GAFA tax," meaning that it is designed to apply primarily to companies such as Google, Apple, Facebook and Amazon—in other words, multinational tech companies based in the United States.
primarily.translationZh: 许多法国政界人士和媒体将其称为"GAFA税"，这意味着该税主要针对谷歌、苹果、脸书和亚马逊等公司——换句话说，就是总部设在美国的跨国科技企业。
primarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

primarily.sentenceEn: Oxytocin is made primarily in the central lower part of the brain, and some of it is released into the bloodstream.
primarily.translationZh: 催产素主要在大脑中央下部产生，其中一部分会释放到血液中。
primarily.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

properly.sentenceEn: Certain artifacts are especially vulnerable because some pioneers in plastic art didn't always know how to mix ingredients properly , says Thea van Oosten, a polymer chemist who, until retiring a few years ago, worked for decades at the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (RCE).
properly.translationZh: 荷兰文化遗产局（RCE）的高分子化学家西娅·范·奥斯滕（Thea van Oosten）表示，某些文物特别脆弱，因为塑料艺术的一些先驱者并不总是知道如何正确调配材料。她在该局工作了数十年，于几年前退休。
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

properly.sentenceEn: As a fellow environmentalist, animal-protection advocate and longtime vegetarian, I could properly be in the same camp as Emma Marris on the issue of zoos.
properly.translationZh: 作为一名环保主义者、动物保护倡导者和长期素食者，在动物园这个问题上，我本可以和艾玛·马里斯站在同一阵营。
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第1句

properly.sentenceEn: A toothy grin (especially when there were gaps or blackened gnashers) lacked class: drunks, tramps, and music hall performers might gurn and grin with a smile as wide as Lewis Carroll's gum-exposing Cheshire Cat, but it was not a becoming look for properly bred persons.
properly.translationZh: 露齿大笑（尤其是牙齿有缝隙或发黑时）会显得缺乏教养：醉汉、流浪汉和杂耍剧场演员或许会挤眉弄眼，咧嘴大笑，笑得像刘易斯·卡罗尔笔下咧嘴露牙龈的柴郡猫一样，但对于有良好教养的人而言，这绝非得体的表情。
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

properly.sentenceEn: Restrictions that keep highly polluting cars out of certain areas—city centres, "school streets", even individual roads—are a response to the absence of a larger effort to properly enforce existing regulations and require auto companies to bring their vehicles into compliance.
properly.translationZh: 限制高污染车辆进入特定区域——市中心、"学校街道"乃至个别路段——是对缺乏更大力度举措的一种回应，这些本应有的举措包括恰当执行现有法规，以及要求汽车公司使其车辆符合标准。
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

properly.sentenceEn: We need to learn how to evaluate them properly .
properly.translationZh: 我们需要学会如何恰当地评估这些论点。

properly.sentenceEn: And if you plan properly , you'll know that you only need, say, 350g of shin of beef and six rashers of bacon, not whatever weight is pre-packed in the supermarket chiller.
properly.translationZh: 而且如果你计划得当，你就会清楚自己确切需要什么，比如350克牛腱肉和六片培根，而不是超市冷柜里那些预包装好的固定重量的商品。
properly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

property.sentenceEn: There are libraries with business and intellectual property centres, which can help business owners and entrepreneurs.
property.translationZh: 一些图书馆设有商业和知识产权中心，可以为企业主和创业者提供帮助。
property.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

property.sentenceEn: As the rules came into effect last Wednesday, property developers were rushing to file plans just before the deadline.
property.translationZh: 随着新规于上周三正式生效，房地产开发商们纷纷赶在截止日期前提交规划申请。
property.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

property.sentenceEn: "Whilst admirable in their intentions, they will add to the cost of housebuilding at a time when many already feel that they are priced out of homeownership," says Jonathan Rolande of the National Association of Property Buyers.
property.translationZh: 全国购房者协会的乔纳森·罗兰德表示：“尽管这些新规的初衷值得赞赏，但它们将进一步增加房屋建设成本，而眼下已有许多人感到自己被排除在购房市场之外。”
property.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第3句

property.sentenceEn: Each spouse retains whatever property he or she brought into the marriage, and jointly-acquired property is divided equally.
property.translationZh: 夫妻双方各自保留婚前带入婚姻的所有财产，婚后共同获得的财产则平均分配。
property.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

property.sentenceEn: Constitutional law is political because it results from choices rooted in fundamental social concepts like liberty and property .
property.translationZh: 宪法 law 具有政治性，因为它源于植根于自由和财产等基本社会观念的选择。
property.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

property.sentenceEn: Thus, in his view, diverse aspects of culture, such as the structure of families, forms of marriage, categories of kinship, ownership of property , forms of government, technology, and systems of food production, all changed as societies evolved.
property.translationZh: 因此，在他看来，文化的各个方面，如家庭结构、婚姻形式、亲属类别、财产所有权、政府形式、技术和食物生产体系，都随着社会的演变而发生变化。
property.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）

proposal.sentenceEn: The proposal is that it should sit alongside the existing city of culture title, which was held by Hull in 2017, and has been awarded to Coventry for 2021.
proposal.translationZh: 该提案建议，这一奖项应与现有的“文化之城”称号并行设立，赫尔市曾于2017年获得该称号，考文垂市则被授予2021年“文化之城”称号。
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

proposal.sentenceEn: Jeremy Wright, the culture secretary, should welcome this positive, hope-filled proposal , and turn it into action.
proposal.translationZh: 文化大臣杰里米·赖特（Jeremy Wright）应当欣然接纳这一积极且充满希望的提案，并将其付诸行动。
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

proposal.sentenceEn: Some might see the proposal as a booby prize for the fact that Britain is no longer able to apply for the much more prestigious title of European capital of culture, a sought-after award bagged by Glasgow in 1990 and Liverpool in 2008.
proposal.translationZh: 有人或许会把这项提议视为一种安慰奖，因为英国已不再有资格申请声望更高的“欧洲文化之都”称号——这一备受追捧的荣誉曾于1990年由格拉斯哥获得，2008年由利物浦摘得。
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

proposal.sentenceEn: Having made their wealth and their reputations elsewhere, they presumably have enough independence to disagree with the chief executive's proposals .
proposal.translationZh: 由于他们在其他领域已经积累了财富和声望，因此想必拥有足够的独立性来对首席执行官的提议提出异议。
proposal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

proposal.sentenceEn: What is the author's attitude towards the proposal ?
proposal.translationZh: 作者对这项提议持什么态度？

proposal.sentenceEn: Despite these factors, many social scientists seem reluctant to tackle such problems. And in Europe, some are up in arms over a proposal to drop a specific funding category for social-science research and to integrate it within cross-cutting topics of sustainable development.
proposal.translationZh: 尽管存在这些因素，许多社会科学家似乎不愿着手解决此类问题。在欧洲，一些社会科学家则对一项提案强烈不满，该提案建议取消社会科学研究的特定资助类别，将其并入可持续发展的跨领域议题中。

prosperity.sentenceEn: Improving living standards and increasing prosperity for more people will require greater use of digital technologies to boost productivity in various sectors, including health care and construction, says Coyle.
prosperity.translationZh: 科伊尔表示，要提高更多人的生活水平并增进繁荣，就需要更多地利用数字技术来提高包括医疗保健和建筑业在内的各个行业的生产力。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

prosperity.sentenceEn: Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
prosperity.translationZh: 严格的解雇法规会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并阻碍繁荣发展和整体福祉。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

prosperity.sentenceEn: Kennedy wrote that the rule "limited states' ability to seek long-term prosperity and has prevented market participants from competing on an even playing field."
prosperity.translationZh: 肯尼迪写道，这一规则"限制了各州追求长期繁荣的能力，并阻碍了市场参与者在公平竞争环境中竞争。"
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

prosperity.sentenceEn: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
prosperity.translationZh: 美国艺术与科学院（AAAS）刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》因其肯定人文与社会科学对美国自由民主的繁荣和安全的重要性而值得称赞。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

prosperity.sentenceEn: Here, too, the problems are social: the organization and distribution of food, wealth and prosperity .
prosperity.translationZh: 然而，这里的问题也具有社会性：粮食、财富和资源的组织与分配方式。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

prosperity.sentenceEn: We tend to think of the decades immediately following World War II as a time of prosperity and growth, with soldiers returning home by the millions, going off to college on the G. I. Bill and lining up at the marriage bureaus.
prosperity.translationZh: 我们往往认为二战结束后的几十年是繁荣发展的时期，数百万士兵返回家园，凭借《退伍军人权利法案》进入大学深造，并在婚姻登记处排起了长队。
prosperity.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

provision.sentenceEn: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation?
provision.translationZh: 考虑到那些数字信息和无形格式的创造者很少为其长期保存做出安排，你是否思考过这些产物的生命周期？
provision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

provision.sentenceEn: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand's Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause.
provision.translationZh: 新西兰《2000年雇佣关系法》（ERA）中的个人申诉条款禁止雇主无正当理由解雇员工。
provision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

provision.sentenceEn: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.
provision.translationZh: 但这些条款在适用于高薪管理人员和高管时，给企业带来了困难。
provision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

provision.sentenceEn: Instead, the digital services tax is part of a much larger trend, with countries over the past few years proposing or putting in place an alphabet soup of new international tax provisions .
provision.translationZh: 相反，数字服务税是一个更广泛趋势的一部分。过去几年，各国纷纷提出或实施各种以字母缩写命名的新型国际税收条款，种类繁多，令人眼花缭乱。
provision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

provision.sentenceEn: If there is a role for government, it should really be getting involved in providing common goods – making sure there is space for playing fields and the money to pave tennis and netball courts, and encouraging the provision of all these activities in schools.
provision.translationZh: 如果政府要发挥作用，那它真正应该做的是提供公共设施——确保有足够的运动场地，投入资金铺设网球和无挡板篮球场，并鼓励学校开展所有这些体育活动。
provision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

provision.sentenceEn: On the overturned provisions the majority held Congress had deliberately "occupied the field" and Arizona had thus intruded on the federal's privileged powers.
provision.translationZh: 对于被推翻的条款，多数法官认为国会已刻意'占据该领域'，因此亚利桑那州侵犯了联邦的特权。
provision.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

permanent.sentenceEn: But the professional companies prospered in their permanent theaters, and university men with literary ambitions were quick to turn to these theaters as offering a means of livelihood.
permanent.translationZh: 但专业剧团在其固定剧院中蓬勃发展，而怀有文学抱负的大学才子们迅速转向这些剧院，将其视为谋生手段。
permanent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

permanent.sentenceEn: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
permanent.translationZh: 这笔资金的大部分将来自两个方面：一是永久性地将每封信的邮资提高1美分，二是将邮政退休人员转入联邦医疗保险(Medicare)体系。
permanent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

permanent.sentenceEn: But in Osborneland, your first instinct is to fall into dependency – permanent dependency if you can get it – supported by a state only too ready to indulge your falsehood.
permanent.translationZh: 但在奥斯本的思维世界里，人们的第一反应是陷入依赖状态——如果能得到的话，最好是永久性依赖——而政府则非常乐于纵容这种错误想法。
permanent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

permanent.sentenceEn: I believe it is precisely this permanent coexistence of metaphysical message through physical means that is the strength of music.
permanent.translationZh: 我认为，正是这种通过物质手段传递形而上学信息的永恒共存，构成了音乐的力量。
permanent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

permanent.sentenceEn: Along with the many folks looking to make a permanent home in the United States came those who had no intention to stay, and who would make some money and then go home.
permanent.translationZh: 在众多希望在美国永久定居的人群中，也有一些人并不打算留下来，他们只想赚些钱然后返回家乡。
permanent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

permanent.sentenceEn: They gave justices permanent positions so they would be free to upset those in power and have no need to cultivate political support.
permanent.translationZh: 宪法制定者赋予法官终身职位，这样他们就能无所顾忌地触犯权贵，也无需寻求政治支持。
permanent.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

philosopher.sentenceEn: They chose this particular behavior for three reasons, according to study co-author Eric Schwitzgebel, a philosopher at the University of California, Riverside: students' attitudes on the topic are variable and unstable, behavior is easily measurable, and ethics literature largely agrees that eating less meat is good because it reduces environmental harm and animal suffering.
philosopher.translationZh: 该研究的合著者、加州大学河滨分校哲学家埃里克·施维茨格贝尔表示，他们选择这一特定行为有三个原因：学生对这一话题的态度多变且不稳定；行为易于测量；伦理学文献普遍认为少吃肉有益，因为这能减少环境危害和动物痛苦。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

philosopher.sentenceEn: As the Chinese philosopher Chuang Tzu is reported to have said: "Happiness is the absence of striving for happiness."
philosopher.translationZh: 正如中国哲学家庄子所言：“幸福在于不刻意追求幸福。”
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第3句

philosopher.sentenceEn: In the end, credibility "happens" to a discovery claim—a process that corresponds to what philosopher Annette Baier has described as the commons of the mind.
philosopher.translationZh: 最终，一个科学发现声明获得可信度是一个过程——这一过程与哲学家安妮特·拜尔所描述的“思想的公共领域”相符。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

philosopher.sentenceEn: Ancient Greek philosopher Aristotle viewed laughter as "a bodily exercise precious to health."
philosopher.translationZh: 古希腊哲学家亚里士多德认为笑是“一种对健康极为珍贵的身体锻炼”。
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

philosopher.sentenceEn: Coinciding with the groundbreaking theory of biological evolution proposed by British naturalist Charles Darwin in the 1860s, British social philosopher Herbert Spencer put forward his own theory of biological and cultural evolution.
philosopher.translationZh: 19世纪60年代，英国博物学家查尔斯·达尔文提出了具有开创性的生物进化论，与此同时，英国社会哲学家赫伯特·斯宾塞也提出了自己的生物和文化进化理论。
philosopher.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

philosopher.sentenceEn: It's not obvious how the capacity to visualize objects and to figure out numerical patterns suits one to answer questions that have eluded some of the best poets and philosophers .
philosopher.translationZh: 尚不清楚，这种想象物体形状和推算数字模式的能力，如何能让人回答那些连最优秀的诗人和哲学家都难以解答的问题。
philosopher.paperLabel: 考研英语 2007 英语（未分卷）
philosopher.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第6句

poll.sentenceEn: Nature's poll findings suggest that this trend is as strong as ever, but, to make a collaboration work, both sides need to invest time, and embrace surprise and challenge.
poll.translationZh: 《自然》杂志的调查结果表明，这一趋势依然势头强劲，但是，要使合作取得成功，双方都需要投入时间，并乐于接受惊喜与挑战。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

poll.sentenceEn: Fewer artists than scientists responded to the Nature poll ; however, several respondents noted that artists do not simply assist scientists with their communication requirements.
poll.translationZh: 在《自然》杂志的这项调查中，艺术家的回应人数少于科学家；然而，一些受访者指出，艺术家并非仅仅是帮助科学家满足其传播需求。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

poll.sentenceEn: Nearly 40% of the roughly 350 people who responded to an accompanying poll said they had collaborated with artists; and almost all said they would consider doing so in future.
poll.translationZh: 在随文附带的调查中，约350名受访者中近40%表示曾与艺术家合作过；几乎所有人都表示未来会考虑这样做。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

poll.sentenceEn: One in three Americans who are at least 40 have or plan to have a job in retirement to prepare for a longer life, according to a survey conducted by Harris Poll for TD Ameritrade.
poll.translationZh: 根据哈里斯民意调查公司为德美利证券开展的一项调查显示，在40岁及以上的美国人中，有三分之一的人已经或计划在退休后继续工作，以应对寿命延长的问题。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

poll.sentenceEn: McClain's little ones aren't the only kids who have an opinion when it comes to housing, and in many cases youngsters' views weigh heavily on parents' real estate decisions, according to a 2018 Harris Poll survey of more than 2,000 U.S. adults.
poll.translationZh: 哈里斯民意调查公司2018年对2000多名美国成年人进行的一项调查显示，在住房问题上，麦克莱恩的孩子们并非唯一有自己想法的孩子，而且在很多情况下，年轻人的意见对父母的房产决策影响很大。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

poll.sentenceEn: One Gallup poll found that 20 percent of Americans who have been unemployed for at least a year report having depression, double the rate for working Americans.
poll.translationZh: 盖洛普的一项民意调查发现，失业至少一年的美国人中有20%报告患有抑郁症，这一比例是在职美国人的两倍。
poll.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

postal.sentenceEn: It is not, however, a sign that they're getting serious about transforming the postal system for the 21st century.
postal.translationZh: 然而，这并不意味着他们正认真考虑为21世纪改革邮政系统。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第7句

postal.sentenceEn: But postal special-interest groups seem to have killed it, at least in the House.
postal.translationZh: 但邮政特殊利益集团似乎已经扼杀了这一提议，至少在众议院是这样。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

postal.sentenceEn: The U.S. Postal Service (USPS) continues to bleed red ink.
postal.translationZh: 美国邮政总局（USPS）继续亏损严重。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

postal.sentenceEn: This is why repeated attempts at reform legislation have failed in recent years, leaving the Postal Service unable to pay its bills except by deferring vital modernization.
postal.translationZh: 这就是近年来多次改革立法尝试均以失败告终的原因，使得邮政总局除了推迟至关重要的现代化进程外，几乎无力支付账单。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

postal.sentenceEn: Most of the money would come from a penny-per-letter permanent rate increase and from shifting postal retirees into Medicare.
postal.translationZh: 这笔资金的大部分将来自两个方面：一是永久性地将每封信的邮资提高1美分，二是将邮政退休人员转入联邦医疗保险(Medicare)体系。
postal.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

postal.sentenceEn: The Postal Service Needs More Than a Band-Aid.
postal.translationZh: 邮政服务需要的不只是权宜之计。

producer.sentenceEn: Farmers' markets are usually weekly or monthly events, most often with outdoor stalls, which allow farmers or producers to sell their food directly to customers.
producer.translationZh: 农贸市场通常是每周或每月举办的活动，大多设有户外摊位，让农民或生产商可以直接向顾客销售他们的食品。
producer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

producer.sentenceEn: Such farming also brings minimal, if any, improvement to the food products (though some producers say their eggs have more protein).
producer.translationZh: 此类 farming 对食品本身的改善即便存在，也微乎其微（尽管一些生产商称其鸡蛋蛋白质含量更高）。
producer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

producer.sentenceEn: So disciplines acquire a monopoly not just over the production of knowledge, but also over the production of the producers of knowledge.
producer.translationZh: 因此，各学科不仅垄断了知识的生产，还垄断了知识生产者的培养。

producer.sentenceEn: The key to reforming higher education, concludes Mr. Menand, is to alter the way in which "the producers of knowledge are produced".
producer.translationZh: 梅南先生总结道，高等教育改革的关键在于改变“知识生产者的培养方式”。

producer.sentenceEn: But senior medical figures want to stop fast-food outlets opening near schools, restrict advertising of products high in fat, salt or sugar, and limit sponsorship of sports events by fast-food producers such as McDonald's.
producer.translationZh: 但是资深医学界人士希望阻止快餐店在学校附近开设，限制高脂肪、高盐或高糖产品的广告，并限制快餐生产商（如麦当劳）对体育赛事的赞助。
producer.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

producer.sentenceEn: "fat taxes" should be imposed on fast-food producers such as McDonald's.
producer.translationZh: 应该对麦当劳等快餐生产商征收“脂肪税”。

province.sentenceEn: Ferraro analyzed satellite data showing annual forest loss from 2008 to 2012—including during Indonesia's phase-in of the antipoverty program—in 7,468 forested villages across 15 provinces .
province.translationZh: 费拉罗分析了2008年至2012年间的卫星数据，这些数据显示了印度尼西亚15个省份7468个森林村庄的年度森林损失情况，其中包括该国扶贫计划的逐步实施阶段。
province.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

province.sentenceEn: What is true of London is even truer of the provinces .
province.translationZh: 伦敦如此，英国其他地区更是如此。
province.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

province.sentenceEn: Instead of having one province – or a series of hospitals within a province – negotiate a price for a given drug on the provincial list, the national agency would negotiate on behalf of all provinces .
province.translationZh: 有了国家机构，就不会再是某个省——或省内某几家医院——就省级药品清单上的某种药品进行价格谈判，而是由国家机构代表所有省份进行谈判。
province.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
province.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

province.sentenceEn: "National" could mean interprovincial – provinces combining efforts to create one body.
province.translationZh: "全国性"也可以指省际间的——即各省携手合作成立一个机构。
province.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
province.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

province.sentenceEn: A small step has been taken in the direction of a national agency with the creation of the Canadian Co-ordinating Office for Health Technology Assessment, funded by Ottawa and the provinces .
province.translationZh: 随着加拿大卫生技术评估协调办公室的成立，在建立国家机构方面已经迈出了一小步，该办公室由渥太华和各省共同资助。
province.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）
province.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第10段，第1句

province.sentenceEn: Of course, the pharmaceutical companies will scream. They like divided buyers; they can lobby better that way. They can use the threat of removing jobs from one province to another. They can hope that, if one province includes a drug on its list, the pressure will cause others to include it on theirs. They wouldn't like a national agency, but self-interest would lead them to deal with it.
province.translationZh: 当然，制药公司会强烈反对。他们喜欢分散的买家；这样他们可以更好地进行游说。他们可以威胁将工作岗位从一个省转移到另一个省。他们可以期望，如果一个省将某种药物列入其清单，这种压力会迫使其他省份也将其列入各自的清单。他们不会喜欢全国性机构，但自身利益会促使他们与该机构打交道。
province.paperLabel: 考研英语 2005 英语（未分卷）

participation.sentenceEn: Innovation and research have relied on public participation in science for centuries.
participation.translationZh: 几个世纪以来，创新与研究一直依赖公众对科学的参与。
participation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

participation.sentenceEn: The growth of specialisation in the nineteenth century, with its consequent requirement of a longer, more complex training, implied greater problems for amateur participation in science.
participation.translationZh: 19世纪专业化的发展使得从事科研活动需要接受更长时间、更复杂的训练，这给业余爱好者参与科学研究带来了更大的困难。
participation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
participation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

participation.sentenceEn: Women's participation in social activities is limited.
participation.translationZh: 女性对社会活动的参与受到限制。
participation.paperLabel: 考研英语 2000 英语（未分卷）

philosophy.sentenceEn: Half of the students in four large philosophy classes read an article on the ethics of factory-farmed meat, optionally watched an 11-minute video on the topic and joined a 50-minute discussion.
philosophy.translationZh: 在四个大型哲学班中，一半的学生阅读了一篇关于工厂化养殖肉类伦理问题的文章，还可以选择观看一个11分钟的相关主题视频，并参与了50分钟的讨论。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

philosophy.sentenceEn: As many took on the duty of trying to integrate reasoning and scientific philosophies into the world, the Renaissance was over and it was time for a new era—the Age of Reason.
philosophy.translationZh: 当许多人开始肩负起将理性思考与科学哲学融入世界的使命时，文艺复兴时代宣告结束，一个全新的时代——理性时代，已然到来。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

philosophy.sentenceEn: It was with these great revelations that a new kind of philosophy founded in reason was born.
philosophy.translationZh: 正是基于这些重大启示，一种以理性为基础的新哲学应运而生。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

philosophy.sentenceEn: Humans are unique in their capacity to not only make tools but then turn around and use them to create superfluous material goods – paintings, sculpture and architecture – and superfluous experiences – music, literature, religion and philosophy .
philosophy.translationZh: 人类的独特之处在于，他们不仅能够制造工具，还能转而使用这些工具创造多余的物质产品——如绘画、雕塑和建筑——以及多余的精神体验——如音乐、文学、宗教和哲学。
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第4句

philosophy.sentenceEn: His concern is mainly with the humanities: literature, languages, philosophy and so on.
philosophy.translationZh: 他主要关注的是人文学科：文学、语言学、哲学等等。

philosophy.sentenceEn: According to the standard history of American philosophy , nowhere else in colonial America was "so much importance attached to intellectual pursuits."
philosophy.translationZh: 根据美国标准哲学史记载，在殖民时期的美洲，没有任何其他地区“如此重视对知识的追求”。
philosophy.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
philosophy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

piracy.sentenceEn: "The people who are stealing our movies and our television shows and operating piracy sites are not mom and pop operations," says Charlie Rivkin, chief executive officer of the MPA.
piracy.translationZh: 美国电影协会首席执行官查理·里夫金表示：“那些窃取我们的电影和电视节目并运营盗版网站的人并非小打小闹的夫妻店。”
piracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

piracy.sentenceEn: "While there is some optimism that emerging countermeasures and best practices may see piracy begin to plateau by 2027, there is no consensus among stakeholders as to when it may begin to decline," says analyst Steve Hawley.
piracy.translationZh: 分析师史蒂夫·霍利表示：“尽管有人乐观地认为，通过采取新的应对措施和最佳实践，盗版活动可能在2027年前后开始趋于稳定，但利益相关者对于盗版何时可能开始减少尚未达成共识。”
piracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第2句

piracy.sentenceEn: But now piracy involving illegal streaming services as well as file-sharing costs the US economy about $30 billion in lost revenue a year and some 250,000 jobs, estimates the US Chamber of Commerce's Global Innovation Policy Center.
piracy.translationZh: 但美国商会全球创新政策中心估计，如今涉及非法流媒体服务和文件共享的盗版行为每年给美国经济造成约300亿美元的收入损失，并导致约25万个就业岗位流失。
piracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

piracy.sentenceEn: Consulting firm Parks Associates predicts that legitimate US streaming services' cumulative loss from piracy since 2022 will reach $113 billion in the next two years.
piracy.translationZh: 咨询公司帕克斯协会预测，自2022年以来，美国合法流媒体服务因盗版造成的累计损失在未来两年将达到1130亿美元。
piracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

piracy.sentenceEn: Rivkin joined the MPA in 2017 after the organization failed five years earlier to build consensus between Hollywood and Silicon Valley to win passage of legislation in Congress aimed at stopping online piracy .
piracy.translationZh: 里夫金于2017年加入美国电影协会(MPA)，而该协会五年前曾试图在好莱坞和硅谷之间建立共识，以推动旨在制止在线盗版的法案在国会获得通过，但未能成功。
piracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

piracy.sentenceEn: Initially the rise of legitimate online businesses such as Netflix actually helped curb digital piracy , which had largely been based on file uploads.
piracy.translationZh: 最初，像Netflix这样的合法在线企业的兴起实际上有助于遏制数字盗版，而当时的盗版主要以文件上传为基础。
piracy.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

prior.sentenceEn: Prior to forming a growth team, the software company BitTorrent had 50 employees working in the traditional departments of engineering, marketing and product development.
prior.translationZh: 在组建增长团队之前，软件公司BitTorrent有50名员工，分别在工程、营销和产品开发等传统部门工作。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

prior.sentenceEn: The share of the population 65 and older was 16% in 2018, up 32% from the prior year, according to the U.S. Census Bureau.
prior.translationZh: 美国人口普查局数据显示，2018年65岁及以上人口占比为16%，较前一年增长32%。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

prior.sentenceEn: Because the California law applies to all boards, even where there is no history of prior discrimination, courts are likely to rule that the law violates the constitutional guarantee of "equal protection".
prior.translationZh: 由于加州这项法律适用于所有董事会，甚至包括那些从未有过歧视历史的董事会，法院很可能会裁定该法律违反了宪法保障的“平等保护”原则。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

prior.sentenceEn: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take.
prior.translationZh: 先验知识和兴趣会影响我们所经历的事情、我们对这些经历的理解，以及我们随后采取的行动。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

prior.sentenceEn: A federal appeals court overturned the prior decision, ruling that Myriad Genetics could indeed hold patents to two genes that help forecast a woman's risk of breast cancer.
prior.translationZh: 一家联邦上诉法院推翻了先前的判决，裁定Myriad Genetics公司确实可以拥有两项基因的专利，这两项基因有助于预测女性患乳腺癌的风险。
prior.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

prior.sentenceEn: It will settle the prior controversies.

profitable.sentenceEn: Ever since taking on Netflix Inc. at its own game, old Hollywood has struggled to turn a profit in streaming, with the likes of Disney+, Peacock and Paramount+ losing billions of dollars each year, sparking concerns that the services will never be as profitable as cable once was.
profitable.translationZh: 自从开始与网飞公司(Netflix Inc.)在其主场展开竞争以来，传统好莱坞在流媒体业务上一直难以实现盈利。迪士尼+、孔雀(Peacock)和派拉蒙+等平台每年亏损数十亿美元，这引发了人们的担忧：这些流媒体服务可能永远无法像有线电视曾经那样盈利。
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

profitable.sentenceEn: "For example, a student with an interest in entrepreneurship could demonstrate skill and potential by starting a profitable small business," Olivia Valdes, the founder of Zen Admissions consulting firm, wrote in an email.
profitable.translationZh: Zen Admissions咨询公司创始人奥利维亚·巴尔德斯在电子邮件中写道：“例如，对创业感兴趣的学生可以通过创办一家盈利的小型企业来展示自己的技能和潜力。”
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

profitable.sentenceEn: They are profitable institutions whose bottom line is much more important than the condition of the animals.
profitable.translationZh: 它们是盈利性机构，其盈亏底线远比动物的生存状况重要得多。
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

profitable.sentenceEn: The concept of sustainable development has been defined as profitable .
profitable.translationZh: 可持续发展的概念已被定义为有利可图的。
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

profitable.sentenceEn: But almost all have ignored the big, profitable opportunity in their own backyard: the wholesale food and drink trade, which appears to be just the kind of market retailers need.
profitable.translationZh: 但几乎所有零售商都忽视了自家后院这个巨大且利润丰厚的机会：食品饮料批发市场，这似乎正是零售商所需要的那种市场。

profitable.sentenceEn: With $3.5 billion being lost on Internet wagers this year, gambling has passed pornography as the Web's most profitable business.
profitable.translationZh: 今年，互联网赌资损失已达35亿美元，赌博业已超越色情业，成为网络上最盈利的行业。
profitable.paperLabel: 考研英语 2006 英语（未分卷）
profitable.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第11段，第4句

paid.sentenceEn: And despite improvements to the premium, paid version, few people were making the upgrade.
paid.translationZh: 尽管高级付费版本已有所改进，但升级的用户寥寥无几。
paid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

paid.sentenceEn: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA'S unjustified dismissal procedures.
paid.translationZh: 高收入经理自身也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中不当解雇程序带来的损害。
paid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

paid.sentenceEn: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives.
paid.translationZh: 但这些条款在适用于高薪管理人员和高管时，给企业带来了困难。
paid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

paid.sentenceEn: This was not a volunteer soldier, not someone well paid , but an average guy, up against the best trained, best equipped, fiercest, most brutal enemies seen in centuries.
paid.translationZh: 他们不是志愿兵，也不是高薪人士，只是普通人，却要面对几个世纪以来最训练有素、装备最精良、最凶猛残忍的敌人。
paid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

paid.sentenceEn: While traditional " paid " media – such as television commercials and print advertisements – still play a major role, companies today can exploit many alternative forms of media.
paid.translationZh: 虽然传统的“付费”媒体——如电视广告和平面广告——仍然发挥着重要作用，但如今企业还可以利用许多其他形式的媒体。
paid.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

paid.sentenceEn: Highly paid managers lose their jobs.

parallel.sentenceEn: The Gutenberg printing press transformed civilisation not by changing the nature of writing but by changing its cost—and it would have achieved little without a parallel collapse in the price of surfaces to write on, thanks to an often-overlooked technology called paper.
parallel.translationZh: 古腾堡印刷机改变了文明，并非通过改变书写的本质，而是通过改变其成本——如果没有另一种常被忽视的技术（即纸张）导致书写载体价格的同步暴跌，印刷机也难以取得多大成就。
parallel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

parallel.sentenceEn: Arizona had attempted to fashion state policies that ran parallel to the existing federal ones.
parallel.translationZh: 亚利桑那州曾试图制定与现行联邦政策并行的州级政策。
parallel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

parallel.sentenceEn: His reports paralleled the "Willie" cartoons of famed Stars and Stripes artist Bill Mauldin.
parallel.translationZh: 他的报道与《星条旗报》著名漫画家比尔·莫尔丁的'威利'系列漫画如出一辙。
parallel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

parallel.sentenceEn: A parallel situation exists in respect of predatory mammals and fish-eating birds.
parallel.translationZh: 肉食哺乳动物和食鱼鸟类也面临着类似的情况。
parallel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

parallel.sentenceEn: Instead, the new habits we deliberately press into ourselves create parallel pathways that can bypass those old roads.
parallel.translationZh: 相反，我们刻意培养的新习惯会形成平行的思维路径，它们能够绕过那些旧路径。
parallel.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
parallel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

parallel.sentenceEn: But brain researchers have discovered that when we consciously develop new habits, we create parallel paths, and even entirely new brain cells, that can jump our trains of thought onto new, innovative tracks.
parallel.translationZh: 但大脑研究人员发现，当我们有意识地培养新习惯时，我们会创建平行路径，甚至生成全新的脑细胞，这些能让我们的思维列车转换到新的创新轨道上。
parallel.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
parallel.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

parenting.sentenceEn: Parenting tips obtained from hunter-gatherers in Africa may be the key to bringing up more contented children, researchers have suggested.
parenting.translationZh: 研究人员指出，从非洲狩猎采集部落获取的育儿技巧或许是培养更满足孩子的关键。
parenting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

parenting.sentenceEn: But defining what it means to be a good parent is undoubtedly very tricky, particularly since children respond differently to the same style of parenting .
parenting.translationZh: 但要定义什么是好父母无疑是非常困难的，尤其是因为孩子们对同样的养育方式会有不同的反应。
parenting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

parenting.sentenceEn: A calm, rule-following child might respond better to a different sort of parenting than, for example, a younger sibling.
parenting.translationZh: 一个沉着冷静、遵守规则的孩子，可能会比另一种孩子——比如弟弟或妹妹——更适应某种特定的教养方式。
parenting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

parenting.sentenceEn: Children of every age benefit from patient parenting .
parenting.translationZh: 各个年龄段的孩子都能从耐心的养育中受益。
parenting.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

participate.sentenceEn: However, college admissions experts say that the quality of a college hopeful's extracurricular activities matters more than the number of activities he or she participates in.
participate.translationZh: 然而，大学招生专家表示，准大学生课外活动的质量比其参与的活动数量更为重要。
participate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

participate.sentenceEn: High school students eager to stand out in the college application process often participate in a litany of extracurricular activities hoping to bolster their chances of admission to a selective undergraduate institution.
participate.translationZh: 渴望在大学申请过程中脱颖而出的高中生，往往会参加一系列课外活动，希望以此提高被名牌本科院校录取的几率。
participate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

participate.sentenceEn: Neither one of them actually participated in any contributions to animal research or conservation.
participate.translationZh: 实际上，这两个机构都未曾对动物研究或保护事业做出任何贡献。
participate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

participate.sentenceEn: Many of the most celebrated national figures have participated in historical events that have taken place within the EEOB's granite walls.
participate.translationZh: 许多最著名的国家人物都曾参与在艾森豪威尔行政办公楼（EEOB）花岗岩墙壁内发生的历史事件。

participate.sentenceEn: In contrast, only five of the 30 children paired with the "unreliable" tester participated in a follow-up activity.
participate.translationZh: 相比之下，在30名与“不可靠”测试者配对的儿童中，只有5名参与了后续活动。
participate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

participate.sentenceEn: High school students participating in a popular activity should excel in it.
participate.translationZh: 参与热门活动的高中生应当在其中表现出色。

passion.sentenceEn: Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.
passion.translationZh: 企鹅兰登书屋的知名作家可能会受到些许影响，但真正盼望这场争端结束的，是那些中游作家——他们通常依赖水石书店员工对推广小众作家作品的热情。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

passion.sentenceEn: "When I come home from a hard day's work, I often feel tired," Danaher says, adding, "In a world in which I don't have to work, I might feel rather different" – perhaps different enough to throw himself into a hobby or a passion project with the intensity usually reserved for professional matters.
passion.translationZh: 达纳赫说：“当我结束一天辛苦的工作回到家时，常常感到疲惫不堪。”他接着补充道：“如果在一个不需要工作的世界里，我的感受可能会截然不同”——这种不同或许足以让他全身心投入到某个爱好或热爱的项目中，其投入程度通常只有对待专业工作时才会有。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

passion.sentenceEn: But if your work is your " passion ," you'll be more likely to devote yourself to it, even if that means going home for dinner and then working long after the kids are in bed.
passion.translationZh: 但如果你的工作就是你的“激情所在”，你就更有可能全身心投入其中，即便这意味着回家吃过晚饭，还要在孩子们入睡后继续工作到深夜。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第4句

passion.sentenceEn: "If you and I parachuted back to Fortune 500 companies in 1990, we would see much less frequent use of terms like journey, mission, passion . There were goals, there were strategies, there were objectives, but we didn't talk about energy; we didn't talk about passion ."
passion.translationZh: 如果我们穿越回到1990年的《财富》500强公司，会发现当时"旅程"、"使命"、"激情"这类词汇的使用频率要低得多。那时候我们谈目标、谈战略、谈指标，但不会谈论干劲，也不会谈论激情。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

passion.sentenceEn: "You have the importation of terminology that historically used to be associated with non-profit organizations and religious organizations: terms like vision, values, passion , and purpose," said Khurana.
passion.translationZh: 库拉纳指出：“现在企业引入了一些历史上通常与非营利组织和宗教组织相关联的术语，比如愿景、价值观、激情和目标。”
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

passion.sentenceEn: "It was a really bad move because that's not my passion ," says Ning, whose dilemma about the job translated, predictably, into a lack of sales.
passion.translationZh: 宁说：“这真是个糟糕的决定，因为那不是我的热情所在。”可以预见，他对这份工作的纠结也体现在了销售业绩不佳上。
passion.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

passionate.sentenceEn: Emma Marris's article is an insult and a disservice to the thousands of passionate people who work tirelessly to improve the lives of animals and protect our planet.
passionate.translationZh: 艾玛·马里斯的文章是对成千上万热心人士的侮辱和伤害，他们为改善动物生活和保护地球而不懈努力。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第1句

passionate.sentenceEn: The same dramatic technological changes that have provided marketers with more (and more diverse) communications choices have also increased the risk that passionate consumers will voice their opinions in quicker, more visible, and much more damaging ways.
passionate.translationZh: 同样剧烈的技术变革在为营销人员提供更多（且更多样化）传播选择的同时，也增加了风险——情绪激动的消费者会以更快、更公开且破坏力大得多的方式表达他们的观点。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

passionate.sentenceEn: Consumers passionate about a product may create "earned" media by willingly promoting it to friends, and a company may leverage "owned" media by sending e-mail alerts about products and sales to customers registered with its Web site.
passionate.translationZh: 对某一产品怀有热情的消费者可能会自愿将其推荐给朋友，从而创造出“口碑媒体”；企业则可以利用“自有媒体”，向其网站的注册用户发送有关产品和促销的电子邮件提醒。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

passionate.sentenceEn: If that happens, passionate consumers would try to persuade others to boycott products, putting the reputation of the target company at risk.
passionate.translationZh: 如果这种情况发生，情绪激动的消费者会试图劝说他人抵制产品，从而将目标公司的声誉置于危险之中。
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

passionate.sentenceEn: DNA testing is also the latest rage among passionate genealogists – and supports businesses that offer to search for a family's geographic roots.
passionate.translationZh: DNA检测也成为了狂热系谱学家们的新宠——同时也催生了一些提供家族地理根源追溯服务的企业。
passionate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

passionate.sentenceEn: I have been transformed from a passionate advocate of the philosophy of "having it all", preached by Linda Kelsey for the past seven years in the pages of She magazine, into a woman who is happy to settle for a bit of everything.
passionate.translationZh: 我已从一个“拥有一切”理念的热情倡导者转变为一个乐于满足于“凡事只求一点”的女人。“拥有一切”这一理念是琳达·凯尔西过去七年来在《她》杂志上大力宣扬的。
passionate.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
passionate.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

peculiar.sentenceEn: The peculiar part is that the journal that the editor is supposedly working for is not profiting at all—it is just providing citations to other journals.
peculiar.translationZh: 奇怪的是，编辑理应效力的期刊根本没有从中获利——它只是在为其他期刊提供引用。
peculiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第5句

peculiar.sentenceEn: Each of these manifestations of growth carried its own peculiar problems in its wake.
peculiar.translationZh: 这种增长的每种表现形式都随之带来了其特有的问题。
peculiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

peculiar.sentenceEn: But the force of geographic conditions peculiar to America, the interplay of the varied national groups upon one another, and the sheer difficulty of maintaining old-world ways in a raw, new continent caused significant changes.
peculiar.translationZh: 但是，美国特有的地理环境因素、不同民族群体之间的相互影响，以及在这片原始的新大陆上维持旧世界生活方式的巨大困难，都带来了显著的变化。
peculiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

peculiar.sentenceEn: It turns out that the peculiar way of conducting the experiments may have led to misleading interpretations of what happened.
peculiar.translationZh: 事实证明，实验所采用的特殊方式可能导致了对所发生情况的误导性解释。
peculiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

peculiar.sentenceEn: The southern states would not have signed the Constitution without protections for the " peculiar institution," including a clause that counted a slave as three fifths of a man for purposes of congressional representation.
peculiar.translationZh: 如果没有对这一“特殊制度”的保护，南方各州是不会签署宪法的，其中包括一项将奴隶算作五分之三个人以确定国会代表权的条款。
peculiar.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）
peculiar.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

peculiar.sentenceEn: Slavery was regarded as a peculiar institution.
peculiar.translationZh: 奴隶制被视为一种特殊制度。
peculiar.paperLabel: 考研英语 2008 英语（未分卷）

perception.sentenceEn: Much of it comes down to your perception of what someone said or did.
perception.translationZh: 这在很大程度上取决于你对他人的言行的理解方式。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第4句

perception.sentenceEn: The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
perception.translationZh: 英国当前局面的成因复杂多样，既包括对生产性林业的过时认知，也涉及灰松鼠对树木的大规模破坏。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

perception.sentenceEn: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.
perception.translationZh: 官员在接见时表现出的偏袒可能会助长公众对腐败的看法。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第1句

perception.sentenceEn: Failing to recognize that, he notes, leads to "an overly simplified view of what the solutions might be. Our perception of the problem and of what the solution is becomes very limited."
perception.translationZh: 他指出，如果未能认识到这一点，就会导致“对可能的解决方案产生过于简化的看法。我们对问题以及解决方案的认知会变得非常有限。”
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第2句

perception.sentenceEn: I had not realised how profoundly marketing trends dictated our perception of what is natural to kids, including our core beliefs about their psychological development.
perception.translationZh: 我之前从未意识到，营销趋势对我们关于儿童天性的认知——包括我们对他们心理发展的核心信念——产生了多么深远的影响。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

perception.sentenceEn: One consideration is safety, or at least the perception of it.
perception.translationZh: 需要考虑的一个因素是安全性，或者至少是人们对安全性的感知。
perception.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

personally.sentenceEn: When you find yourself taking a situation personally , try to think of other interpretations that are less focused on you — especially in the sense of saying anything deep or fundamental about you.
personally.translationZh: 当你发现自己对某种情况过于敏感、认为是在针对自己时，试着去寻找其他不那么以你为中心的解释——特别是要意识到，这件事并不代表对你个人深度或本质上的定性。
personally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

personally.sentenceEn: When you take things personally , you're interpreting these situations as saying something significant and negative about you as a person.
personally.translationZh: 当你把事情看作是针对个人时，你实际上是将这些情况解读为对自己人格的重大否定。
personally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

personally.sentenceEn: And if someone can't help right now, avoid taking it personally .
personally.translationZh: 如果有人现在帮不上忙，不要把这当成针对你个人的行为。
personally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第3句

personally.sentenceEn: "I personally have never seen all that much intellectual value in memorizing things," Sparrow says, adding that we haven't lost our ability to do it.
personally.translationZh: 斯派洛说：“我个人从不认为记忆事物有那么多的智力价值。”她补充道，我们并没有失去记忆能力。
personally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第6句

personally.sentenceEn: And people made car-buying decisions that were both objectively better and more personally satisfying when asked to focus on their feelings rather than on details, but only if the decision was complex—when they had a lot of information to process.
personally.translationZh: 此外，当人们被要求专注于自己的感受而非细节时，他们做出的购车决定不仅在客观上更佳，也更能满足个人需求——但这仅适用于复杂的决策，即当他们需要处理大量信息时。
personally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

personally.sentenceEn: Kids tend to get stuck in the features and the immediate benefits to them personally , Norris said.
personally.translationZh: 诺里斯说，孩子们往往只关注房子的特色以及这些特色给自己带来的即时利益。
personally.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第13段，第1句

physician.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
physician.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

physician.sentenceEn: "Some states require physicians to report, others allow but do not mandate reports, while a few consider a report a breach of confidentiality. There could be liability and penalties if a physician does not act in accordance with state laws on reporting and confidentiality," she counseled.
physician.translationZh: 她建议道：“有些州要求医生报告，有些州允许但不强制报告，还有少数州则认为报告是对保密性的侵犯。如果医生未按照州有关报告和保密的法律行事，可能会承担责任并面临处罚。”
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

physician.sentenceEn: John Ioannidis, a physician who studies research methodology, says that the policy is "a most welcome step forward" and "long overdue".
physician.translationZh: 研究方法论的内科医生约翰·约安尼迪斯表示，这一政策是“向前迈出的非常受欢迎的一步”，而且“早就应该实施了”。
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

physician.sentenceEn: As a physician , I know the most costly and dramatic measures may be ineffective and painful.
physician.translationZh: 作为一名医生，我深知那些最昂贵、最激进的治疗手段可能既无效又痛苦。
physician.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

physician.sentenceEn: Physicians —frustrated by their inability to cure the disease and fearing loss of hope in the patient—too often offer aggressive treatment far beyond what is scientifically justified.
physician.translationZh: 医生们因无力治愈这种疾病而感到沮丧，又担心患者失去希望，常常采取超出科学依据的激进治疗方案。
physician.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

physician.sentenceEn: And thanks to the continual miniaturization of electronics and micro-mechanics, there are already robot systems that can perform some kinds of brain and bone surgery with submillimeter accuracy—far greater precision than highly skilled physicians can achieve with their hands alone.
physician.translationZh: 而且，得益于电子器件和微机械技术的不断微型化，已经出现了能够进行某些脑部和骨科手术的机器人系统，其精度可达亚毫米级——这远非技术精湛的医生仅靠双手就能达到的精准度。
physician.paperLabel: 考研英语 2002 英语（未分卷）
physician.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

policymaker.sentenceEn: This concept has served as a central goal for curriculum developers, local school boards, business and community leaders, and policymakers ever since its introduction nearly 80 years ago.
policymaker.translationZh: 自近80年前被提出以来，这一概念一直是课程开发者、地方学校委员会、商业与社区领袖以及决策者们的中心目标。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

policymaker.sentenceEn: Such debates reflect fierce discussions across the US, as researchers, policymakers , teachers and students step up demands for a greater focus on teaching about the facts of climate change in schools.
policymaker.translationZh: 此类争论反映了全美范围内的激烈讨论，研究人员、政策制定者、教师和学生都在不断呼吁，要求学校更加重视气候变化事实的教学。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

policymaker.sentenceEn: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
policymaker.translationZh: 但如果政策制定者能将精力重新集中在改善民众福祉上，而非仅仅纠结于GDP数据，就能避免预测中的厄运，甚至可能看到进步。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第7段，第2句

policymaker.sentenceEn: The question of GDP and its usefulness has annoyed policymakers for over half a century.
policymaker.translationZh: 半个多世纪以来，GDP及其实用性问题一直困扰着政策制定者。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

policymaker.sentenceEn: This "brain drain" has long bothered policymakers in poor countries.
policymaker.translationZh: 这种“人才流失”长期困扰着贫困国家的政策制定者。
policymaker.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

policymaker.sentenceEn: policymakers have little drive for science education.
policymaker.translationZh: 政策制定者对科学教育缺乏动力。

positively.sentenceEn: When we wear clothes that make us feel comfortable and confident, it can positively affect our self-esteem and overall mood.
positively.translationZh: 当我们穿着令自己感到舒适且自信的衣服时，这能对我们的自尊心和整体情绪产生积极影响。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

positively.sentenceEn: By instilling best practices in AI engagement and creating policies that evolve with the technology, businesses can positively shift the AI landscape.
positively.translationZh: 通过逐步建立AI互动的最佳实践，并制定随技术演进的政策，企业能够积极地改变人工智能领域的格局。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

positively.sentenceEn: And the stock market reacts positively when companies tie CEO pay to, say, stock prices, a sign that those practices build up corporate value not just for the CEO.
positively.translationZh: 此外，当公司将首席执行官的薪酬与（比如说）股价挂钩时，股市会做出积极反应，这表明这些做法不仅为首席执行官个人，也为公司整体创造了价值。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

positively.sentenceEn: It says that the problem is not merely that people do bad science, but that our current system of career advancement positively encourages it.
positively.translationZh: 该论文指出，问题不仅仅在于人们从事劣质科研，更在于我们当前的职业晋升体系对这种行为起到了积极的鼓励作用。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第3句

positively.sentenceEn: Nor was there any evidence that those who self-enhanced the most (that is, the participants who thought the most positively doctored pictures were real) were doing so to make up for profound insecurities.
positively.translationZh: 也没有任何证据表明，那些自我美化程度最高的人（即那些认为经过最大程度美化的照片才是真实自己的参与者）这样做是为了弥补内心深处的不安全感。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

positively.sentenceEn: During the Depression and the war, Americans had learned to live with less, and that restraint, in combination with the postwar confidence in the future, made small, efficient housing positively stylish.
positively.translationZh: 在大萧条和战争时期，美国人已经学会了简朴生活，这种克制再加上战后对未来的信心，使得小巧高效的住房成为绝对的时尚。
positively.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第2句

possess.sentenceEn: Beginning in 2006, some scientists have argued that plants possess neuron-like cells that interact with hormones and neurotransmitters, forming "a plant nervous system, analogous to that in animals," said lead study author Lincoln Taiz.
possess.translationZh: 研究主要作者林肯·泰兹表示，自2006年起，一些科学家就认为植物拥有类神经元细胞，这些细胞能与激素和神经递质相互作用，形成"类似于动物神经系统的植物神经系统"。
possess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

possess.sentenceEn: His paternal grandparents, a steward and a housekeeper, possessed even less status, having been servants, and Dickens later concealed their background.
possess.translationZh: 他的祖父母是管家和佣人，曾做过仆役，社会地位更低，狄更斯后来隐瞒了他们的出身背景。

possess.sentenceEn: For them, history did nothing, it possessed no immense wealth nor waged battles: "It is man, real, living man who does all that."
possess.translationZh: 在他们看来，历史本身无能为力，它既不占有巨大财富，也不发动战争：“是人类，是现实中活生生的人创造了这一切。”
possess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第3句

possess.sentenceEn: These epochal figures represented lives hard to imitate, but to be acknowledged as possessing higher authority than mere mortals.
possess.translationZh: 这些划时代人物的人生虽难以效仿，但其拥有的超越凡人的崇高权威却是公认的。
possess.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

possess.sentenceEn: However, many leading American universities want their undergraduates to have a grounding in the basic canon of ideas that every educated person should possess .
possess.translationZh: 然而，许多美国顶尖大学都希望本科生能在那些每一位受过教育的人都应掌握的基础思想经典方面打下坚实基础。

possess.sentenceEn: Professionalism has turned the acquisition of a doctoral degree into a prerequisite for a successful academic career: as late as 1969 a third of American professors did not possess one.
possess.translationZh: 专业化已将博士学位的获取变成学术事业成功的必要前提：直到1969年，仍有三分之一的美国教授没有博士学位。

prediction.sentenceEn: They reimagined the 300-year-old score by injecting the latest climate prediction data for each season—provided by Monash University's Climate Change Communication Research Hub.
prediction.translationZh: 他们对这部有300年历史的乐谱进行了重新构思，融入了由莫纳什大学气候变化传播研究中心提供的最新季节性气候预测数据。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

prediction.sentenceEn: When it comes to AI in business, we often hear about it in relation to automation and the impending loss of jobs, but in what ways is AI changing companies and the larger economy that don't involve doom-and-gloom mass unemployment predictions ?
prediction.translationZh: 谈到商业领域的人工智能，我们常常听到它与自动化以及随之而来的失业风险相关联，但人工智能在哪些方面正在改变企业和整体经济，而不涉及那些悲观的大规模失业预测呢？
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

prediction.sentenceEn: A different and not mutually exclusive prediction holds that the future will be a wasteland of a different sort, one characterized by purposelessness: Without jobs to give their lives meaning, people will simply become lazy and depressed.
prediction.translationZh: 另一种预测（与前者并不相互排斥的）认为，未来将是另一种荒芜之地，其特征是漫无目的：没有工作赋予生活意义，人们只会变得懒惰和消沉。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

prediction.sentenceEn: Indeed, predictions have been around for two decades but have not yet come to fruition.
prediction.translationZh: 事实上，有关无现金社会的预测已存在二十年之久，但至今仍未实现。
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第3句

prediction.sentenceEn: Many of its predictions are available online at www.straitford.com.
prediction.translationZh: 该公司的许多预测都可在其网站www.straitford.com上获取。
prediction.paperLabel: 考研英语 2003 英语（未分卷）
prediction.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

prejudice.sentenceEn: But he's also found a kind of insidious prejudice .
prejudice.translationZh: 但他也发现了一种潜在的偏见。
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

prejudice.sentenceEn: Divorced persons may remarry, but a gender prejudice shows up: The divorced male doesn't have a waiting period before he can remarry while the woman must wait ten months.
prejudice.translationZh: 离婚人士可以再婚，但存在性别偏见：离婚男性可以立即再婚，无需等待期，而女性则必须等待十个月。
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第4句

prejudice.sentenceEn: It needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need.
prejudice.translationZh: 政府需要摒弃历史偏见，采取一些措施来解决我们迫切的住房需求。
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

prejudice.sentenceEn: To take advantage of this tool, some impoverished countries will have to get over their outdated anti-colonial prejudices with respect to foreign investment.
prejudice.translationZh: 为了充分利用这一工具，一些贫困国家必须摒弃在外国投资问题上那些过时的反殖民偏见。
prejudice.paperLabel: 考研英语 2001 英语（未分卷）
prejudice.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

preservation.sentenceEn: At the time of creation, no attempts were made at intentional preservation , yet analog materials have a chance of surviving and serving as the historical record that biographers, historians, and novelists rely on.
preservation.translationZh: 在创作之时，人们并未刻意进行保存，但这些模拟材料却有可能幸存下来，成为传记作者、历史学家和小说家所依赖的历史记录。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第4句

preservation.sentenceEn: Have you pondered the life cycle of intangible formats, digital information, given that those who produce these artifacts seldom make provision for their long-term preservation ?
preservation.translationZh: 考虑到那些数字信息和无形格式的创造者很少为其长期保存做出安排，你是否思考过这些产物的生命周期？
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

preservation.sentenceEn: Libraries and archives have traditionally shouldered the responsibility of organization, preservation , and access to information.
preservation.translationZh: 图书馆和档案馆历来肩负着信息的组织、保存与获取的责任。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第5句

preservation.sentenceEn: As a librarian whose day job revolves around special collections and digital assets, I share the night terrors of historians, and I'd be lying if I said a comprehensive preservation solution currently exists.
preservation.translationZh: 作为一名日常工作围绕特藏文献和数字资产展开的图书馆员，我与历史学家们有着同样的梦魇。如果说目前存在一个全面的保存解决方案，那我一定是在撒谎。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第1句

preservation.sentenceEn: Despite success stories like van Oosten's, preservation of plastics will likely get harder.
preservation.translationZh: 尽管有像范·奥斯滕这样的成功案例，但塑料文物的保护工作可能会变得更加困难。
preservation.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第6段，第1句

prioritize.sentenceEn: What you need to do is prioritize growth by establishing a growth team.
prioritize.translationZh: 你需要做的是通过组建增长团队来优先推动业务增长。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

prioritize.sentenceEn: Teri Byrd: Zoos should have been closed down as they prioritize money making over animals' wellbeing.
prioritize.translationZh: 特里·伯德：动物园早就该关闭了，因为它们把赚钱看得比动物的福祉更重要。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

prioritize.sentenceEn: Do your best to engage coworkers in a genuine, back-and-forth conversation, rather than prioritizing your own thoughts.
prioritize.translationZh: 尽力与同事进行真诚的双向交流，而非只关注自己的想法。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第5句

prioritize.sentenceEn: That's only a small share of the total acreage that could benefit, about half a million acres in all, so it will be vital to prioritize areas at greatest risk of fire or drought.
prioritize.translationZh: 这仅仅是可受益总面积中的一小部分，总共约50万英亩，因此，优先处理火灾或干旱风险最高的区域将至关重要。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

prioritize.sentenceEn: They did not always prioritize the protection of Mauna Kea's fragile ecosystems or its holiness to the island's inhabitants.
prioritize.translationZh: 他们并非始终将保护莫纳克亚山脆弱的生态系统或其对岛上居民的神圣意义放在首位。
prioritize.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第3句

prioritize.sentenceEn: Zoos should have been closed down as they prioritize money making over animals' wellbeing.
prioritize.translationZh: 动物园早就该关闭了，因为它们把赚钱置于动物福祉之上。

privilege.sentenceEn: "The American Medical Association advises physicians that 'in situations where clear evidence of substantial driving impairment implies a strong threat to patient and public safety, and where the physician's advice to discontinue driving privileges is ignored, it is desirable and ethical to notify the Department of Motor Vehicles,'" Menke wrote.
privilege.translationZh: 门克写道：'美国医学协会建议医生，'当有明确证据表明驾驶员存在严重驾驶障碍，对患者本人及公共安全构成严重威胁，且医生关于终止驾驶特权的建议被忽视时，通知机动车管理部门是可取且符合伦理的做法。'
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

privilege.sentenceEn: Symbolic of national unity as they claim to be, their very history – and sometimes the way they behave today – embodies outdated and indefensible privileges and inequalities.
privilege.translationZh: 尽管君主们声称自己是国家统一的象征，但他们的历史——有时还有他们如今的行事方式——却体现着过时且站不住脚的特权与不平等。
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

privilege.sentenceEn: The only major objection came from Justice Antonin Scalia, who offered an even more robust defense of state privileges going back to the Alien and Sedition Acts.
privilege.translationZh: 唯一的主要反对意见来自大法官安东宁·斯卡利亚，他对州特权提出了更为有力的辩护，其依据可追溯至《外侨与煽动叛乱法》。
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第5段，第2句

privilege.sentenceEn: These are the kind of workers that countries like Britain, Canada and Australia try to attract by using immigration rules that privilege college graduates.
privilege.translationZh: 而英国、加拿大、澳大利亚等国家正是通过制定优先录取大学毕业生的移民政策，努力吸引这类人才。
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

privilege.sentenceEn: "Intellect is resented as a form of power or privilege ," writes historian and professor Richard Hofstadter in Anti-intellectualism in American Life, a Pulitzer-Prize winning book on the roots of anti-intellectualism in US politics, religion, and education.
privilege.translationZh: 历史学家兼教授理查德·霍夫施塔特在其普利策奖获奖著作《美国生活中的反智主义》中写道：“才智被视为一种权力或特权而遭到憎恶。”这本书探讨了美国政治、宗教和教育领域反智主义的根源。
privilege.paperLabel: 考研英语 2004 英语（未分卷）
privilege.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

productive.sentenceEn: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK's net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity.
productive.translationZh: 虽然生产性植树能够为农村经济带来实实在在的经济效益，并有助于英国实现净零战略目标，但政府的支持重点仍然放在粮食生产以及仅以生物多样性为目的的荒野恢复和本土林地种植上。
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第1句

productive.sentenceEn: The causes of the UK's current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels.
productive.translationZh: 英国当前局面的成因复杂多样，既包括对生产性林业的过时认知，也涉及灰松鼠对树木的大规模破坏。
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第3句

productive.sentenceEn: They're more productive , more creative, and willing to take greater risks.
productive.translationZh: 他们的工作效率更高，创造力更强，也更愿意承担更大的风险。
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第2句

productive.sentenceEn: We need them to imagine the United States as a place where they can be productive for a while without committing themselves to staying forever.
productive.translationZh: 我们需要让他们将美国视为一个可以暂时发挥才干、无需承诺永久居留的地方。
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第2句

productive.sentenceEn: Only when humanity began to get its food in a more productive way was there time for other things.
productive.translationZh: 只有当人类开始以更具生产力的方式获取食物时，才有时间去做其他事情。
productive.paperLabel: 考研英语 2009 英语（未分卷）
productive.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第4段，第5句

productive.sentenceEn: Provide more support for productive tree planting.
productive.translationZh: 加大对生产性植树的支持力度

publicly.sentenceEn: Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane, the publicly controlled group that owns train operator Trenitalia and the national train network RFI, said 23 percent of all high-speed trains it operated were late in 2023.
publicly.translationZh: 意大利国家铁路公司（Ferrovie dello Stato Italiane）表示，其运营的所有高铁中，2023 年的晚点率达 23%。该公司是一家控股铁路运营商 Trenitalia 和国家铁路网 RFI 的国有企业。
publicly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句

publicly.sentenceEn: And now Climate Change agitators are attacking publicly displayed works in European museums.
publicly.translationZh: 而现在，气候变化激进分子正在攻击欧洲博物馆中公开展出的作品。
publicly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第8段，第7句

publicly.sentenceEn: The Dutch giant Elsevier, which claims to publish 25% of the scientific papers produced in the world, made profits of more than £900m last year, while UK universities alone spent more than £210m in 2016 to enable researchers to access their own publicly funded research; both figures seem to rise unstoppably despite increasingly desperate efforts to change them.
publicly.translationZh: 荷兰出版巨头爱思唯尔(Elsevier)声称出版了全球25%的科学论文，去年利润超过9亿英镑；而仅英国的大学在2016年就花费了超过2.1亿英镑，以使研究人员能够获取他们自己的公共资助研究成果。尽管人们愈发迫切地试图改变这种局面，但这两个数字似乎都在持续上涨，势不可挡。
publicly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第1句

publicly.sentenceEn: It is true that CEO pay has gone up—top ones may make 300 times the pay of typical workers on average, and since the mid-1970s, CEO pay for large publicly traded American corporations has, by varying estimates, gone up by about 500%.
publicly.translationZh: 确实，首席执行官的薪酬有所上涨——顶级CEO的薪酬平均可能是普通员工的300倍，而且自20世纪70年代中期以来，据各种不同估计，美国大型上市公司首席执行官的薪酬上涨了约500%。
publicly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第1段，第1句

publicly.sentenceEn: "Short-termism" or the desire for quick profits, has worsened in publicly traded companies, says the Bank of England's top economist, Andrew Haldane.
publicly.translationZh: 英国央行首席经济学家安德鲁·霍尔丹表示，上市公司中的“短期主义”——即追求快速获利的欲望——愈演愈烈。
publicly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第2段，第1句

publicly.sentenceEn: So they compared U.S. cities' average happiness measured by Gallup polling with the investment activity of publicly traded firms in those areas.
publicly.translationZh: 因此，他们将盖洛普民意调查所测得的美国城市平均幸福感与这些地区上市公司的投资活动进行了比较。
publicly.positionLabel: 文章原文 · 第3段，第2句
